tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag bzhugs sau/ /
༄༅/ /sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag bzhugs sau/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag bzhugs sau//

༈ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ spyir dal 'byor gyi lus thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang 'phrad/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i blo skyes nas dam pa'i chos phyin ci ma log pa cig byed dgos/ de la zhen pa bzhi dang bral ba cig nyams su len dgos/ de gang zhe na/ tshe 'di la ma zhen pa/ khams gsum 'khor ba la ma zhen pa/ bdag gi don la ma zhen pa/ dngos po dang mtshan ma la ma zhen pa'o/ de bshad na/ tshe 'di chu'i chu bur dang 'dra bas nam 'chi nges pa med pas zhen pa bya rin mi chog khams gsum 'khor ba 'di dug gi 'bras bu dang 'dra bas 'phral zhim yang phugs su gnod pa skyel/ su zhen par byed pa tsho 'khrul/ rang gi don la zhen na dgra bo'i bu gsos pa dang 'dra// 'phral dga' dga' ltar byed kyang phugs su rang la gnod pa skyel nges/ des na rang don la zhen na 'phral bde yang phugs ngan song du 'gro'o// dngos po dang mtshan ma la mngon par zhen na smig rgyu la chur 'dzin pa dang 'dra/ 'phral chur snang yang khar btung rgyu med/ 'khor ba 'di blo 'khrul pa la snang yang shes rab kyis brtags na ngo bor grub pa ci'ang med/ des na 'das pa la sems mi gzhug ma 'ongs pa la sems mi gzhug da lta ba la rnam par shes pa mi gzhug pa cig go bar byas nas/ chos thams cad spros bral du shes par bya'o// de ltar byas pas tshe 'di nyid la ma zhen pas ngan song du mi skye/ khams gsum la ma zhen pas 'khor bar mi skye/ bdag gi don la ma zhen pas nyan rang du mi skye/ dngos po dang mtshan ma la ma zhen pas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o// zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag phyin ci ma log pa dpal sa skya pa chen po'i thugs dgongs sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sbyar ba rdzogs so// // ༄༅// 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// ༈ na mo gu ru madz+nyu gho ṣa ya/

dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi spyi bor pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs nas// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// rgyal kun yab gcig rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs// de dang dbyer med sa skya paṇa chen zhabs// byams mgon rnam 'phrul g.yag ston sangs rgyas dpal// rong ston chen po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rig pa'i dbang phyug dge ba rgyal mtshan dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes grags 'bras mo ba// mkhas pa'i dbang phyug yon tan rgya mtsho dang*// tshe dbang bkra shis rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje 'chang dbang blo gsal rgya mtsho dang*// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug zhabs// mkhas shing grub brnyes dbang phyug rab brtan dang*// ngag dbang chos grags rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams dang*// de sras ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs// rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub dang*// kun dga' legs 'byung rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' blo gros dang*// gang des rjes bzung kun dga' mkhas grub dbang*// mkhas pa'i rigs 'khrungs nam mkha' 'chi med zhabs// kun dga' bstan 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dpal dpa' bo mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*// snyigs dus bstan pa'i sgron me blo gter dbang*// rgyal kun spyi gzugs brag ra rdo rje 'chang*// gzhan phan snying po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi// byin rlabs nyi zer blo mtshor 'char ba yis// ma rig mun pa'i tshogs kun drung phyung nas// shes bya'i gzugs kun 'gogs med 'char bar shog /khyad par byang chub sems kyi rgyud phyug nas// rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa mthar phyin te// rigs gsum sems dpa'i rnam thar 'dzin pa yis// nam mkha' mtha' klas 'gro 'di skyong bar shog

/ces pa'ang lam bzang 'di la mos ldan slob bu lha dbang rnam rgyal nas bskul ngor/ gnubs rigs gzhan phan pas gsol ba btab pa'o// // ༄༅// 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas/ bde ba'i bstan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'dug la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i ngo bor gyur pa'i 'jam dbyangs dmar ser chos 'chad ut+pal glegs ral can dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa rdor skyil gis bzhugs pa'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs bla ma dang sangs rgyas su mos pa'i drung du bdag dang mar gyur sems can thams cad 'khod nas 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyis kun nas bslangs te byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa gsum sogs ci nus brjod/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes brjod pas/ skyabs yul de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ skyabs su 'gro ba po rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib dag sangs rgyas su gyur nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs/ skyabs yul rang la thim pa'am mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum sogs kyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa sa chos thams cad snang stong sgyu ma lta bur sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi ze'u 'bru la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid ngo bo 'jam dbyangs la rnam pa paṇ+ḍi ta sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad nas ut+pa la'i yu ba nas bzung ba'i me tog snyan g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i g.yas kyi steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang*/ g.yon gyi steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pu sti yod pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ dbu la sa zhu dang*/ sku la chos gos rnam gsum ngur smrig gsol ba/ de'i dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i chos rje la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim pas de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur

par bsam/ de nas rang gi lus kyi gsang gnas nas spyi bo'i bar rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba sbom phra sba lcag tsam gyi kha tshangs bug tu phye ba'i nang du chos kyi rje'i gdan pad+ma'i yu ba zug pa/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal bar gyur par bsam la ngag tu brjod cing gsal btab/ de nas bdag la skyid sdug legs nyes mtho dma' ci byung yang chos rje nyid las re sa gzhan na med pas thugs rjes gzigs shig snyam pa'i mos gus drag po snying gi dkyil nas dung lhang lhang pa dang bcas/ shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan yangs pa// 'gro kun dge legs sgrub pa'i thugs rje can// bsam yas phrin las mdzad pa'i stobs mnga' ba// 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal// sh+lau ka gcig brgya stong nas bdun gyi bar brjod/ ༈ /chos kyi rgyal po 'gro ba du ma'i mgo /gdul bya'i don du dpal ldan sa skya ru// chu pho dge byed dpyid zla ra ba yi// nyi shu drug la bltams pa nas bzung ste// sprul pa'i gnas su lcags phag smal po yi// bcu bzhi'i tho rangs zhi bar gshegs kyi bar// rab tu ngo mtshar rnam thar dpag med rnams// mdor bsdus 'chad la gus pas mnyan par bgyis// byang chub sems kyi klu dbang spyi bo'i steng*// yon tan dpag med rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// shes rab zag med yum gyi rgya mtshor zhugs// dbang 'byor khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// bltams pa'i dus na 'od kyis 'jig rten khyab// yum la ma gnod bde ba'i rnam pa rgyas// mkha' 'gro'i dbang po dpag yas mkha' la 'dus// mi mchog khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi ma mo ma bslab khong du chud// gzhon nu'i dus na yon tan thams cad rdzogs// mkhas pa du mas tshogs kyi dbus su bstod// blo ldan khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// mi nas mir gyur skye ba nyi shu lngar// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung gyur pas// bzo dang gso ba sgra tshad nang don rig

/mtshungs bral khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// srid pa kun tu legs par sbyangs pas na// rmi lam na yang chos kyi sgo rnams kun// dge ba'i bshes kyis dngos su gdams par mdzad// rnam dag khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// zab mo'i lam gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe// rje btsun bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gzigs// skad cig gcig la chos rnams thugs su chud// thugs grol khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// thabs kyi lam gyis 'byung bzhi rab tu sbyangs// ngag gi bzlas pas khro rgyal dngos su gzigs// bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pa mchog tu gyur// skyon bral khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// rtog ge ngan pa'i rgol ba thams cad bzlog /rloms pas khengs pa'i rtog ge zil gyis gnon// mkhas pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad khyab// 'jigs bral khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// yongs su 'dzin pa'i rtog pa kun tu spong*// chos kyi sbyin pa rtag tu lhug par gtong*// gzhan gyi don la bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i// brtse ldan khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// gdul bya'i don du bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan tshe// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang byams mgon blo ldan dang*// zhi ba lha dang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis// bsnyung gsol khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// bsam pa dag pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig gis// 'jam pa'i dbyangs su mig gis mthong gyur cing*// 'phags pa'i yul na'ang gtam du de ltar grags// lhun grub khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// shing mo sbrul gyi dbyar zla 'bring po dang*// lcags pho khyi yi ston zla tha chung tshe// lcags mo phag la gzhan don 'gro zhes gsungs// dus mkhyen khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// mig 'phrul lta bu'i ting 'dzin la gnas nas// bsnyung mi mnga' yang gdul bya 'ga' zhig gi /sgrib pa sbyang phyir bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i// bsam yas khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// le lo can rnams brtson pa bskyed pa dang*// skal dman rnams la dge ba spel ba'i phyir// sku tshe'i 'du byed yang yang byin gyis brlabs// mnga' brnyes khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// gzhan don gshegs pa thugs la 'khrungs pa'i tshe// sems med sa yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos// bya rnams kun kyang ca co du ma sgrogs// byams chen khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// dkyil 'khor sgrubs pa'i cho ga mdzad pa'i tshe// bla ma rnams dang kyai yi rdo rje yi// dkyil 'khor lha rnams mngon sum gzigs par gyur// dbang ldan khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag gis dbu la byug

/rje btsun sgrol ma nam mkha'i mthongs su byon// 'jam dbyangs mgon po yang dang yang du gzigs// khyu mchog khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// sgra dbyangs mi zad sgrogs pa'i rgyal po dang*// shākya seṅge slob mar bcas pa sogs// sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du ma yang yang gzigs// mi phul khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun mthu stobs nag po'i zhal snga nas// khyod ni nyi ma rgyal po'i bur gyur tshe// dri ma med dpal sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur zhes// lung bstan khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// gsang ba'i gnas ni lta bas mi mngon zhing*// dbu yi gtsug tor mchog tu gsal por 'phags// smin mtshams mdzod spu kha ba dung ltar 'khyil// mtshan ldan khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// rol mo'i sgra rnams mkha' las yang yang grags// 'ja' 'od rnam pa'i gdugs dang ba dan 'phyar// lha rnams shugs kyis sa yang rab tu g.yos// nyer zhi khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// byams pa'i stobs kyis skye bo dpag med 'dus// lha mi'i mchod pa phul du byung ba brnyes// sku gdung ring bsrel dad ldan rten du bzhag /phan dgongs khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// skye ba skye ba rnams su yang dang yang*// mkhas pa mkhas pa'i tshogs la sngon sbyangs pas// tshe 'dir lan re zung re thos tsam gyis// gzhung lugs kun shes kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal// bzang po'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i rnam par thar ba mdor bsdus te/ rigs par smra ba yar klungs pa yis sbyar/ tshar gsum mam gcig brjod la/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ chos rje'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥdamar ser gyi mthar mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du oṃ a ra pa tsa na zhes pa kha dog dmar ser gyis bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/

sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ chos rje'i thugs ka'i dhīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ de las 'od zer dmar ser gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad sbyangs/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skyes par gyur/ ces dang spro bsdu'i dmigs pa de yang yang gsal 'debs pa dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes thun re la brgya stong khri sogs ci 'grub dang*/ bsnyen pa byed na 'bum phrag brgyad bcu tsam bzla'o// gang ltar yang thun gyi rjes su 'jam mgon bla ma nyid la mos gus dung ba dang bcas phyogs bcu dus gsum ma tshig lhug gi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa'am/ bsdu na/

dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo mkhyen rab kyi bdag po 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ chos rje'i dpral ba'i oṃ las bdud rtsi dkar po babs/ sku'i nang brgyud gdan pad+ma'i yu ba la 'khril nas rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i dngos grub thob/ chos rje'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas bdud rtsi dmar po babs/ rang gi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dngos grub thob/ chos rje'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi sngon po babs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ chos rje'i gnas gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las bdud rtsi dkar dmar sngo gsum 'dres pa 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pa lta bu babs/ rang gi sgo gsum la thim/ lus kyi nang gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ chos rje de rang gi spyi bo'i rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas zhugs/ de ma thag tshangs bug gi sgo 'grigs/ lus gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du snying pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi ze'u 'bru la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du 'ja' 'od kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gur gyi nang na dus rtag tu 'bral ba med par bzhugs par gyur/ ces dang*/ nang gi mchod pa phul bar bsams la/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// yon tan me tog tshul khrims bdug spos sprin// shes rab sgron me dad pa spos chu'i mtsho// ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zhal zas dam pa dang*// bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan sgra 'byin zhing*// kun nas snying brtse rnam dpyod spobs pa yi// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng ba yis// bdag lus gzhal med khang brtsegs rab brgyan nas// snying ga'i chu skyes thig le zla rgyas la// brtan par bzhugs pa'i chos rje mchod bgyid cing*// nges par 'dun pa'i yid kyis gsol btab pas// 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig

/sa skya paṇa chen rtag tu mnyes gyur cig / ces brjod la yang dag pa'i don la blo bzhag pa ni lus gnad dang ldan pas chos rje'i thugs d+dhiḥyig nyi ma'i mdog can de la shes pa gtad nas/ chos rje'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres pa bde stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la rtog pa'i bsre lhad ci'ang mi bya bar ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag thun las ldang bar 'dod na/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i// lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs// myur du bsgrubs nas tshe 'di kho na la// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la bgrod par shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i zhing*// sa skya paṇa chen byang chub brnyes pa'i gnas// mngon dga'i zhing du bdag cag dpon slob rnams// tshe 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /de nas bde ba can sogs sa skya pa'i// rje btsun gong ma bzhugs pa dag pa'i zhing*// mang du bgrod nas spang rtogs myur rdzogs te// sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /sems can nad pa ji snyed pa// myur du nad las thar gyur cig /'gro ba'i nad ni ma lus pa// rtag tu 'byung ba med par shog /phyogs rnams kun na lus dang sems// sdug bsngal nad pa ji snyed pa// de dag bdag gi bsod nams kyis// bde dga' rgya mtsho thob par shog /phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa// de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur// 'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni// mthun par gyur cing re ba'ang 'grub par shog /byang phyogs skyong ba'i skyob pa mchog gyur pa// mkhas grub rgya mtshos yongs su gang ba'i gnas// gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bstan pa gsal mdzad pa// sa skya pa yi bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /gangs can bod kyi lte ba rdo rje gdan// dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid rgyas gyur cig /sprul pa'i gdung brgyud rgyun chad med pa dang*// kun kyang phrin las nam mkha' mnyam par shog

/'gro ba'i bla ma chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// mkhyen rab dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs// rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog / ces sogs bkra shis bya'o// zhes 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la brten pa'i 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshul 'di'ang*/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab nas byung ba bzhin la/ rang gi rgyun du nyams su len tshul ji lta ba bzhin bcos bslad med par sbyar ba 'di yi gsol 'debs dang*/ smon lam rnams 'di dang 'brel chags gang yin rang gi blos dpyad nas bya ba yin la nges sbyar mi dgos shing*/ yig rnying rnams nas nyin mo spyi bo dang mtshan mo snying gar bsgoms nas bzlas pa byed mi byed 'dam ka mdzad kyang gong gi des ma 'thus pa ci'ang med pas 'di bzhin nyams su blangs na gnas skabs su las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med du 'grub cing mthar thug chos rje nyid kyi go 'phang thob par gdon mi za'o// //sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ maṅga la bha ba tu// // ༄༅// sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// ༈ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi spyi bor pad+ma'i gdan zhugs nas// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// thub pa'i dbang po rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs// ngag dbang grags pa rdo rje gdan pa dang*// ba ri lo tsā grub chen gle nag par// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// bshes gnyen sgre pa mnyam med sgam po pa// sgom tshul shes rab byang chub 'dul 'dzin zhabs// 'bri gung gling pa dam chos gling pa la// gsol ba 'debs so= /chos kyi tshul khrims mnyam med lha lung pa// thog gnas pa dang chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs// skye dgu'i 'dren mchog byang chub bzang po la// gsol ba 'debs so=

/thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis rnam rgyal zhabs// bsod nams lha dbang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan dang*// mkhas grub dbang po rje btsun phrin las par// gsol ba 'debs so= /tshar chen rje dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dbang phyug rab brtan dang*// bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub la// gsol ba 'debs so= /(mkhyen rab byams pa rmor chen gnas gsar ba// kun dga' blo gros kun dga' mkhas grub dbang*// rigs kun khyab bdag kun dga' bstan 'dzin la// gsol ba 'debs so= /yid bzhin 'khor lo ngur smrig gar gyi rol// mkhyen brtse'i dbang po thugs sras dh+wa dza'i mtshan// mkhan chen dpal chos shar chen 'jam dbyangs rje// gsol ba 'debs so= /)(kun dga' bstan 'dzin mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la// gsol ba 'debs so= /blo gros rgyal mtshan blo gter dbang po dang*// kun spangs chen po chos kyi nyi ma rje// rigs kun khyab bdag gzhan phan snying po la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// )rgyal ba'i yum mchog rje btsun bcom ldan ma// yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku yi snang brnyan ni// blo mtshor shar ba'i mod nas 'chi bdag bdud// ming gi mthar byas 'chi med 'grub par shog /snying dbus zla ba'i 'khor lor yig 'brur bcas// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar 'babs pa yis// lus kun phyur bur gtams pa'i dga' ston gyis// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub 'grub par shog /'od zer drug sbrags ldan pa'i srung 'khor ni// ut+pal gsar pas bar mtshams kun khyab pa// sra brtan rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsgoms pa yis// mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar shog / ces pa 'di yang ban+de blo gsal gyis sbyar ba bkra shis par gyur cig gong gi brgyud pa'i kha skong tshar chen man mañdzu gho ṣas sbyar ba dge'o// // ༄༅// sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi nyams len snying por bsdus pa nag 'gros bklags chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so//

༈ /na mo gu ru ār+ya tā ye/ zla shel pad+mo bzhad pa'i lte ba las// zla ba zhun ma'i yid 'phrog lang tsho can// zla shel mthong bas dga' bde'i dpal ster mas// zla ba'i chu rgyun bdud rtsis ring du skyongs// rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas tshe sgrub par byed pa'i thabs ches zab pa tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun du grags pa'i nyams len snying por bsdus te rgyun du nyams su len 'dod pas/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug ste/ skyabs yul zhing khams yongs su dag pa'i dbus su ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing gi sdong po'i steng pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba/ mdun gyi 'dab ma la sgrol dkar sogs yi dam/ g.yas su sangs rgyas thub pa'i dbang po sogs sprul sku'i rnam pa/ rgyab tu gsung rab pusti brtsegs pa/ g.yon du nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs dge 'dun/ gzhan yang skyabs yul rnams kyis dpag bsam shing gi yal ga lo ma me tog gi khrod thams cad gang ba la dmigs nas bdag gzhan thams cad lus ngag yid gsum 'jug pa gcig tu dril nas/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas= /dam pa'i chos= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// nyer gcig sogs/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o//

lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma la bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ār+yā tā re sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ ār+yā tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / bar lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo tām̐ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing nor bu chu shel dri ma med pa ltar dwangs shing 'od 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas ut+pa la dkar po'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i brdar rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum du gyes pa'i dbus kyi me tog kha phye ba/

g.yas 'bras bu/ g.yon gang bu'i rnam par yod pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud ltag par bcings shing lan bu ring du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag zhabs kyi mthil rnams la spyan re re ste ye shes kyi spyan bdun mnga' ba/ zla ba'i rgyab yol dang 'od kor can/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ oṃ ār+yā tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas/ shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tut+tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// pad+ma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa'i// zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du// rdo rje skyil krung bcas mdzad ma// mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs 'dra zhing*// zla ba la ni rgyab brten ma// rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs// ut+pal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan// rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras// 'dod sbyin sku ni 'chang ba'i yum// 'phags ma sgrol mar phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo dkar po 'od zer dkar// rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad// yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can// 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo//

zhes pas bstod/ lha'i sku snang stong dbyer med la sems gtad de ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag de nas bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud lnga dang ldan pa'i lte bar tām̐ yig dkar po/ de'i mtha' skor du/ ma ma ā yuḥpuṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru zhes pas bskor ba/ de'i mdun du oṃ/ rgyab tu hā/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā/ zhes pa'i yig 'bru re yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud nang ma la/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa g.yon skor du yod pa/ de phyi rol gyi mu khyud la/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ zhes pa g.yas skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la/ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa da ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī mahā shra ma ṇa/ zhes pa g.yas skor du yod pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas skor du yod par bsam/ de nas/ spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang nyid kyi phyi rol tu 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa sbubs can zhwa theb kha sbyar ba lta bu g.yas skor du 'khor ba me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas gdon bgegs gnod byed thams cad bya sgro mgar gyi sol mal du babs pa ltar gzhob thul thul tshig par gyur par bsam/

yang snying ga'i tām̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po zla ba stong dus cig tu shar ba lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'khor lo'i phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od dkar po'i gur khang du gyur/ zhi ba'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par gyur

par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer ser po gser zhun ma lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad rgyas par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od dkar po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od ser po'i gur khang du gyur/ rgyas pa'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par gyur par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar po byi ru'i mdog lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdus/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od ser po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od dmar po'i gur khang du gyur/ dbang gi phrin las thams cad 'grub par gyur par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer mthing ga 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshar bcad/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od dmar po'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od mthing ga'i gur khang du gyur/ drag po'i phrin las thams cad 'grub par gyur par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer ljang gu margad zhun ma'i mdog lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad gcig char du 'grub par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od mthing ga'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od ljang gu'i gur khang du gyur/ phrin las thams cad 'grub par gyur par bsam/ yang snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer mchin kha 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dngos grub thams cad brtan par byas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od ljang gu'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du 'od mchin kha'i gur khang du gyur/ byin rlabs dang phrin las thams cad brtan par gyur par bsam/ 'od kyi gur khang drug po thams cad kyang dbyibs sgo nga'i rnam pa lta bu dum bu gcig tu gyur pa sra zhing mkhregs pa/

bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang gzhig par mi nus pa/ bar mtshams thams cad ut+pal sngon po me tog kha phye ma thag pa gsar zhing mnyen lcug dang ldan pas bun long gis gtams par gyur par bsam/ rang nyid rje btsun mar gsal ba nas bzung 'od zer mchin kha'i gur khang gi bar du sems 'dzin cing*/ snang stong gi ngang du mnyam par 'jog de bzhin du phyi nas rim bzhin du thugs ka'i tāṃ yig gi bar du sems 'dzin cing snang stong dbyer med kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog de nas spyi bo'i tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bum nang du song bas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur/ de nyid gyen du 'phyur zhing kha nas lud pas rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sbyangs 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur par bsams la/ rlung bum pa can nyer gcig gam bdun nam gsum gyi bar du 'dzin/ de nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar gyi rgyun dang 'od zer dkar po sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad mer gyis khengs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad byang zhing dag 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang bdud rtsi'i zil pa phram mer yod par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla/ dmigs pa nam mi gsal ba'i dus snying ga'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi 'bebs shing 'od zer spro bsdu'i tshig gong bzhin brjod la/

sngags dang dmigs pa sprad de ye ma yengs par bzlas pa'i rjes su sngar ltar/ oṃ ār+yā tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ā li kā li ye dharmā yig brgya rnams tshar gsum res byin rlabs brtan zhing lhag chad kha bskang*/ de nas thugs ka'i tām̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas de rnams 'od du zhu nas 'od mchin kha'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od ljang gu'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od mthing ga'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od dmar po'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od ser po'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od dkar po'i gur khang la thim/ de 'khor lo'i gur khang la thim/ de rang rje btsun mar gsal ba la thim/ de thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ de tām̐ yig la thim/ de'i khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da yang mi dmigs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur par bsam la/ ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag rtog pa 'phro na / rang skad cig gis rje btsun ma'i skur gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis gnas gsum bsrung la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba yi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / sogs kyis smon lam dang bkra shis brjod do// de ltar sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo la/ jo bo rje nas brgyud pa/ gnyan lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa/

kha che paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī nas brgyud pa ste/ bod yul du brgyud pa'i bka' srol mi 'dra ba bzhi tsam byon pa'i man ngag gi snying po bsdus pa/ gtso che ba ba ri ba'i slob brgyud bla ma gle nag pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgre pa la gnang ba'i nyams len ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud dang bcas pa 'di ni tshe sgrub kyi man ngag la zab pa'i mthar thug par grags so// zhes tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe sgrub khyad par can 'od zer drug sbrags ma rgyun du nyams su len tshul tshar chen yab sras kyi gsung lhan cig tu bkod cing sogs khong rnams kyang nag 'gros dkyus gcig tu bris pa 'di yang gnyer dpon bsod nams mchog ldan nas ngos kyi rim gror dgon khag sogs su sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub 'jug 'dun la yig cha zhal gsal can dgos zhes bskul ngor sa skya pa kun blos mgyogs par sbyar ba dge'o// // sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// mtshan mchog gsum ldan 7skyabs mgon 7gong ma bdag khri rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' theg chen dpal 'bar phrin las bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po'i brtan bzhugs 'gyur med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'chi med mi shigs srung ba'i gur khang nang*// 'chi med tshe sbyin lha mo spyan bdun ma// 'chi med tshe la dbang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// rigs gsum pad+ma'i thugs bskyed lha lam nas// mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i rang gzugs nyin mor byed// sa bstan lung rtogs pad tshal rgyas mdzad nas// gdul bya gling bzhi'i mgon du rtag brtan gsol// ngag dbang sgyu 'phrul lha rigs 'khon gyi gdung*// 'gro kun dga' mdzad theg chen mdo sngags lam// phan bde'i dpal du 'bar ba'i phrin las can// bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po zhabs brtan gsol// rnam dag khrims ldan gser gyi sa gzhi la// thos bsam sgom pa'i rin chen rdul mang brtsegs// 'chad rtsod rtsom dang rjes bstan bang rim rgyas// skyabs mchog ri dbang lhun por brtan bzhugs gsol// rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun gong ma lngas// rgyal bstan gcig bsdus snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi// rgyal ba'i lam bzang zab mo slob bshad rnams// rgyal ba ji bzhin ston mdzad zhabs brtan gsol// phun tshogs rgyal srid bdun gyi bkra shis dpal// dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'bar nas// gnas mchog 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan du byon// byon bzhin gsang gsum rdo rje ltar brtan gsol// bslu med bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje dang*// yi dam bstan srung rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs dang*// chos nyid zab mo 'gyur med bden pa'i mthus// ji ltar gsol ba'i 'dod don grub gyur cig

/ces mtshan mchog gsum ldan gdung sras ngag dbang kun dga' theg chen dpal 'bar phrin las bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po'i brtan bzhugs 'gyur med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas/ dpal nā len+d+ra'i mkhan ming shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang blo gros rin chen nam/ tha snyad rig pa'i btags ming 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'bad med lhun gyis grub par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// shar chen klu lding mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsol 'debs drang song bden smon rdo rje'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i spobs pa'i gter chen tshogs// dbyangs can dga' mas cig tu spungs pa'i dpyid// bstan pa'i spyi nor srid mun drung 'byin pa'i// theg chen chos kyi nyi ma 'tsho bzhes gsol// byams pa'i dpal gos brtse ba'i ge sar can// dmigs med snying rje'i yal 'dab 'bol ba'i khrod// zab dgu'i mkhyen rtogs 'dab stong dgod pa'i phul// rnam 'dren bye ba'i gtsug rgyan 'tsho bzhes gsol// chos can kun rtogs snang cha ji snyed tshogs// gzhan dbang gdan gsum dkyil 'khor rol mor 'char// chos nyid yongs grub bde chen ye shes kyi// don ston gsung gsang 'dzin pa 'tsho bzhes gsol// tshogs gnyis nor 'dzin ma mas bskyed bsrings pa'i// rnam gsum khrims kyi nor bu'i rkang 'thung mchog /don gnyis 'bras bu'i g.yur za khur ldan sku// mi shigs rdo rje'i chos bdun grub par smon// rtse gcig gsol ba'i ma la ya rlung gis// rjes brtse'i sprin sngon phung po g.yo ba las// grub gnyis bdud rtsi'i thig phreng phebs pa dang*// sku bzhi'i 'bras bzang mchog gi smin pa stsol// zhes pa'ang bstod yul nyid la dad pa'i slob bu rnams kyi re skong phyir shar pa mkhan mañdzu'i ming can gyis smras pa don can du gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ 7gong sa mchog gi zhabs brtan bzhugs so// gangs ri rwa ba'i bskor ba'i zhing khams su// phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// spyan ras gzigs dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yi// zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar du brtan gyur cig// / ༄༅// 7skyabs mchog dz+nya na badz+ra rin po che'i 7zhabs brtan rdo rje'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swasti/ 'gro la 'chi med mchog sbyin tshe yi lha// bla ma drang srong grub rigs rgya mtsho yi// byin brlabs dngos grub mdzad pa med pa'i gter// 'gyur med rtag pa dam pas shis pa stsol// 'gro la kun dga'i dpal sbyin rin chen gsum// gcig bsdus rigs gsum mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gar// 'khon gdung dri med ngo mtshar sprul pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan zhabs brtan gsol// ji snyed shes bya thugs chud mkhas pa'i rtse// ji bzhin gnas lugs mngon gyur grub pa'i phul// 'gro khams rjes 'dzin thugs bskyed zla med pa// bstan pa'i srog shing chen por zhabs brtan gsol// srid zhi mnyam gzigs 'jam mgon brtse ba che// brtan mkhas shes bya kun mkhyen paṇ+ḍi ta// mthu stobs bdag nyid 'khon ston rim byon gyi// rgyal tshab dam par skal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// de ltar lhag bsam dag pas gsol btab don// chos nyid bden mthu mchog gsum bla ma lhas// bden tshig 'grub pa'i grogs dan g.yel med kyis// zhabs brtan phrin las 'phel ba'i dge legs stsol// ces bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal sa skya pa chen po sgrol pho'i 7skyabs mchog bdag khri rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gdung sras gnyis pa rin po che mtshan dpe gsar bzhad la mtshan gsol dang 'brel zhabs brtan sh+lau ka lnga zhig gsar rtsoms kyi 'bul dgos zhes mjal dar nang mdzod dang rten bcas bka' phrin gser ltar lci ba dwang du blangs te don grub ces pa sa mo lug gi lo hor zla 11tshes 14'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i dus chen nyin bla mchod rgyas gshoms thog mtshan gsol gyis ji phebs mtshan bkra'i zhabs brtan tshigs bcad dbang po'i grangs ldan lo zla de ga'i tshes 22'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po che'i dus chen nyin bla mchod mchod sprin dang 'brel bco brgyad khri ming lce btsun su bha ṣi tas lum+bi ni'i gtsug lag khang du gang dran gsol ba btab pa sarba dza ga tam//

// ༄༅// 7klu lding mkhan rin po che mchog gi zhabs brtan bzhugs so// ༈ ngag la dbang bsgyur 'jam dbyangs sa skya pa'i// zab rgyas chos kyi rgyal mtshan srid zhi'i rtser// sgrengs slad mkhas btsun dpal yon bzang po can// zhabs pad brtan cing phrin las rgyas gyur cig/ // ces pa 'di sa skya khri 'dzin pas sbyar ba'o// ༄༅// mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i zhabs brtan bzhugs so// ༈ mkhas mang gser ri'i dbus na lhun po ltar// rab brjid gzhung rgya 'chad la zla med pa'i// ngag gi dbang phyug mkhas mchog sa skya pa// yon tan bzang po'i zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /gsung ngag rin chen dbang 'byor bslab gsum gyi// yon tan nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'od zer 'bum phrag can// bstan 'gro'i mgon du zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /de ltar gsol bas bshes gnyen ngag dbang mtshan// sku tshe mi 'gyur rdo rje'i chos bdun gyi// yon tan kun rdzogs tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes// bzang po'i phrin las sa gsum khyab par shog/ // ces zhabs brtan tshe yi rig 'dzin grub pa'i shis brjod ces bya ba 'di ni/ mkhan chen rin po che gang gi zhal slob dge bshes 'jam dbyangs legs bshad dang*/ rin chen yar 'phel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ nges don dbang po/ 'bri ru dgon mkhan lung rigs seṅge rnam pas lha reg a she dang hin sgor brgya rten bcas bskul ngor/ chos smra'i btsun gzugs kun dga' dbang phyug gis/ rab byung bcu bdun lcags lug khrum zla'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes la/ bhir rdzong slob tu bris par/ ji ltar smon pa bzhin 'grub ste rnam par rgyal gyur cig/ // ༄༅// zhabs brtan smon tshig 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gru char zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ rab mdzes mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan yid kyi mtshor// 'phos pa'i mod la 'chi med mchog stsol ba'i// 'phags ma tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo yis// deng 'dir 'chi med grub pa'i dga' ston stsol// rigs gsum zlos gar rje btsun sa skya pa'i// 'gro kun dga' mdzad thabs mkhas 'phrin las kyis// srid zhi'i phan bde'i 'dzum pa'i dpal ster ma// mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang mo zhabs brtan gsol// sku tshe'i 'du byed bskal pa rgya mtshor brtan// dam pa'i tshul dgus dpal gyis rab mdzes shing*// gzhan phan 'phrin las mkha' ltar khyab pa yi// bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog

ces pa 'di yang rang rigs rje btsun chung ngu'i 'khrungs skar theng dang po'i skabs 'don rgyu dgos zhes rmo rmo lags nas bskul ma mdzad pa bzhin 'khon rigs khri 'dzin ngag dbang kun dgas gnas chen lum bhi tshal bkra shis rab brtan gling dgon par sbyar ba de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ // ༈ dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// dkar phyogs dga' ba'i mthu dang nus pa yis// rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin 'jam dbyangs yab sras sogs// sku tshe ring zhing phrin las rgyas gyur cig /bla ma sku khams bzang la gsol ba 'debs// mchog tu sku tshe ring la gsol ba 'debs// phrin las dar zhing rgyas la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs// sku tshe ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*// bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*// snyan grags nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa yis// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog ༈ /rnam 'dren thub pa'i dbang po yi// yongs rdzogs chos kyi rgyal srid la// dbang bsgyur dpal ldan sa skya pa'i// bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /thub pa'i rgyal tshab sa skya pa'i// ring lugs 'dzin pa kun gyi mchog /rgyal ba kun dga' bzang po yi// bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /chos kyi rgyal po e wam̐ pa'i// thun min snyan brgyud gdams pa'i rgyun// gcig bsdus tshar chen chos kyi rje'i// bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /brtse chen rgyal ba'i dbang po yi// mdo rgyud man ngag zab mo'i mdzod// 'dzin mkhas kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi// bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po dang*// gsang bdag blo gter dbang po yi// bka' srol gdams pa ji snyed pa// phyogs dus kun tu 'bar gyur cig / ces pa 'di yang rā dza pur sa skya'i chos sgar gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs legs grub kyi lhums bzhugs dus chen nyin thog ma'i rten 'brel skabs gsar rtsoms bgyis pa'i khar/

da lam shing bya lo'i smon lam stabs bstun sho lo ka gnyis gsar gnan bcas 'khon rigs khri 'dzin sgrol ma pho brang pa ngag dbang kun dgas sbyar ba don dang ldan par gyur cig// /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa nyung gsal bzhugs so// slob bshad brgyud 'debs/ ༄༅// rnam dag dkyil 'khor bzhi yi 'dzin ma la// rnam dkar dbang bzhi'i char rgyun legs phab nas// rnam grol sku bzhi'i lo tog rgyas mdzad pa// rnam mkhyen bla ma bzhi la gsol ba 'debs// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang bdag med ma// mthu stobs dbang phyug grub chen nag po pa// ḍā ma rū pa a wa dhū tī pa// ga ya dha ra rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar dpal ldan sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs/ 'di nas sh+lau ka phyed bzhi 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa'o/ /bud+dhā shrī dang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// sems dpa' chen po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// brgyud gsol kun bsdus bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*// kun spang chos rje blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhabs// mkhyen brtse dbang phyug bslab gsum rgyal mtshan zhabs// dbang phyug rab brtan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog sgrub dang*// mkhyen rab byams pa rmor chen gnas gsar rje// kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// kun dga' bstan 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// blo gros snying po kun dga' 'jam dbyangs zhabs// blo gter dbang po chos kyi nyi ma'i rje// gzhan phan snying po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'og min chos dbyings rdo rje'i pho brang du// zab gsang snyan brgyud dam pa'i mdzod bzung nas// skal ldan 'gro rnams smin cing grol mdzad pa'i// 'dren mchog dbang gi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs//

sh+lau ka bse ru ngor klu lding mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzad*/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin brlabs kyis// nges 'byung byang chub sems gnyis snying la shar// 'bras bu'i yon tan thos pas yid spro ste// gsang chen lam la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// bskyed pa phyi dbyibs rdul tshon dkyil 'khor du// bum pa'i dbang bskur bskyed rim lam bsgoms pas// rtsa yi 'gros kyis lus kyi sgrib sbyangs nas// sprul sku'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// bha ga byang sems nang gi dkyil 'khor du// gsang ba'i dbang bskur gtum mo'i lam bsgoms pas// yi ge'i 'gros kyis ngag gi sgrib sbyangs nas// longs sku'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// kun rdzob byang sems gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du// gsum pa'i dbang bskur pho nya'i lam bsgoms pas// bdud rtsi'i 'gros kyis yid kyi sgrib sbyangs nas// chos sku'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// don dam byang sems mthar thug dkyil 'khor du// bzhi pa'i dbang bskur rba rlabs lam bsgoms pas// rlung gi 'gros kyis sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs nas// ngo bo nyid sku thob par byin gyis rlobs// gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i gzhung 'di ni shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// // de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du// mthun rkyen rgyal bas bsngags pa kun tshang nas// bsam don chos dang mthun pa legs 'grub ste// srid zhi'i phun tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / sh+lau ka 'dimakhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'o// thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// yon tan me tog tshul khrims bdug spos sprin// shes rab sgron me dad pa spos chu'i mtsho// ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zhal zas dam pa dang*// bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan sgra 'byin cing*// kun nas snying brtse rnam dpyod spobs pa yi// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng ba yis// bdag lus gzhal med khang brtsegs rab brgyan te// snying ga'i chu skyes thig le zla rgyas la// brtan par bzhugs pa'i chos rje mchod byed cing*// nges par 'dun pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na// 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig

/ ces pa 'di chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'o// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus ldan// dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog /bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa thams cad kyang*// las 'bras lhur len gsung rab don la mkhas// tshul khrims dag cing thos la mngon brtson pas// thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad du gsol// rgyal mtshan rtse mor dbang gi rgyal po ltar// lhag pa lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gcig pu// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog// / dge'o// // ༄༅// dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'bring du bya ba yan lag drug pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshrī tsakra nā tha rat+na war+dhā ya/ kun khyab thabs la mkhas pa'i snying rje dang*// rnam kun mchog ldan 'od gsal shes rab che// dbyer med dges pa rdo rje la btud de// rgyal ba rigs drug sgrub thabs bshad kyis nyon// 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su nub mo chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du nyal/ tho rangs lha sku bde ba chen po'i nga rgyal gyis langs/ bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na khrus bya/ mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la/ bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas kha shar phyogs su bltas te 'dug la/ skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsan rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/

hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ rdo rje khrag 'thung dam tshig rjes su skyong*/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ khrag 'thung nyid kyis nye bar gnas par mdzod/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ bdag la brtan par mdzad du gsol/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu dges par mdzod/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol/ sarba karma su tsa me/ las kun la yang bdag gi ni/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ sems la dge legs su ni mdzod/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka bcom ldan rdo rje khrag 'thung du/ mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ bdag grol khrag 'thung nyid du mdzod/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ dam tshig sems dpa' chen po āḥ ces ci nus kyi mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur// // ༄༅// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gyi mchog

/zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi// nyams len gsang ba'i nye lam bzhugs// sde gzhung mchog sprul a 'jam zhabs kyi zhal rgyun man ngag mchan can/ ༈ rgyal ba sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang*// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam yas bir+wa pa// mtha' yas rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// shes bya kun gzigs rje btsun bsod nams rtse// bdag nyid chen po rje btsun rin po che// bstan pa'i sgron me sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// gsol ba 'debs so= /mkhas grub chen po tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal// dus gsum gzigs pa'i gnyen chen bsod nams brtan// rlung sems dbang 'byor chos rje brag phug pa// gsol ba= /thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i bdag po dpal ldan pa// chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun bla ma gnyis// gsol ba= /rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po dang*// rgyal sras thu bo dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug la// gsol ba= /grub pa'i dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel// chos kyi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i zhabs// mkhas pa'i dbang phyug dkon mchog lhun grub la// gsol ba= /mkhas pa'i rigs 'khrungs nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*// mkhas pas rjes bzung bla ma dpal ldan pa// mkhas pa'i rgyud 'dzin shes rab 'byung gnas la// gsol ba= /sems dpa' chen po dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// skyabs kun gtso bo rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams thams cad la// gsol ba 'debs so= /mi bzod phung khrol bskyed pa'i rgyur gyur pa// bdag tu bzung ba'i yo byad ci mchis rnams// dpal ldan bla ma'i nyer mkhor 'bul lags kyi// 'dzin chags ser sna zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// 'jigs rung 'khor ba chags sdang 'phel ba'i rgyu// dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba ci mchis pa// rje btsun bla ma'i bran du 'bul lags kyi// chags sdang rang sar dag par byin gyis rlobs// nyes kun rtsa ba bdag 'dzin phung po 'di// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas// chos rje bla ma mnyes phyir 'bul lags kyi// bdag 'dzin rtsad nas thon par byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsum ngo bo nyid// gnas gsum yig 'bru'i tshogs las 'od 'phros pas// lus ngag yid la dbang bzhi bskur byas nas// lhan skyes ye shes skye bar byin gyis rlobs// cir snang thams cad rang gi sems su shes// sems kyang sgyu ma lta bur thag chod la// de yang spros kun bral bar rab rtogs nas// gnas lugs brjod bral bsgom par byin gyis rlobs//

zhes pa lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //na mo gu ru pā dā ya/ dben pa'i gnas su bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'dug la/ dal 'byor gyi rten la snying po len par 'dod pa'i 'dun pas lus ngag yid gsum 'jug pa rtse gcig tu bsgrims te/ bla ma la sangs rgyas su nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir du snying thag pa nas 'di ltar brjod cing bsam mo// bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' yi// mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus pa// dus 'di nas ni byang chub ma thob bar// phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rnams// gcig tu bsdus pa sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i gnas// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun gyi mnga' bdag che// dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi// spangs rtogs mthar phyin ston pa sangs rgyas la// sgo gsum gus pa= /lung rtogs bdag nyid bstan pa dam chos la// sgo gsum= /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// sgo gsum= / zhes lan mang du brjod/ bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rin po che// rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// khyed kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs// dam chos lam du longs par= /lam gyi 'khrul par zhi bar= /'khrul snang dbyings su 'char bar= /'di nas /chos min rnam rtog 'gag par= (/las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag par= /rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar=) /byams dang snying rje skye bar= /byang chub sems gnyis 'byong bar= /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs//

zhes lan gcig dang*/ (sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig ces pa lan gsum sogs gang thub brjod/ ) ma gyur 'gro rnams srid las bsgral ba'i phyir// bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya// de yi ched du sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod/ chos dbyings 'od gsal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// 'jigs med seṅges btegs pa'i rin chen khri// sna tshogs chu skyes nyin byed dkyil 'khor dbus// tshangs dbang khyab 'jug drag po brtsegs pa'i steng*// 'khor lo'i mgon po drin chen chos kyi rje// rtsa ba'i bla ma dges pa rdo rje'i sku// zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag can zhabs bzhi pa// bdag med yum dang rol pa'i gar gyis bzhugs// gang de'i dpral mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐// pad nyi'i gdan la 'od dang gzi brjid 'bar// gzugs phung rnam snang tshor phung rin chen 'byung*// 'du shes snang mtha' 'du byed don yod grub// rnam shes mi bskyod kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang*// sa khams spyan ma chu khams mā ma kī// me khams gos dkar rlung khams sgrol ma che// nam mkha' rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma// 'dren byed sa snying sgra 'dzin gsang ba'i bdag /dri 'dzin nam snying ro 'dzin spyan ras gzigs// sku lus sgrib sel yid dbang 'jam pa'i dbyangs// tshigs mtshams kun bzang rtsa rgyus byams pa mgon// phyag g.yas dus dgra g.yon pa gzhan mi thub// zhal sgo rta mgrin rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil// dpung g.yas mi g.yo g.yon pa 'dod pa'i rgyal// pus g.yas dbyug sngon can dang g.yon stobs chen// spyi gtsug 'khor sgyur zhabs mthil gnod mdzes rgyal// zag med yul rnams gzugs sgra dri ro dang*// reg dang chos khams rdo rje lha mo yi// ngo bor bzhugs pa rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog

/gzhan yang de mthar brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems// nyan thos rang rgyal chos skyong srung ma dang*// nor lha'i tshogs rnams dges bzhin bzhugs par gyur// de nas dad gus kyi shugs drag pos gang drin ma'am/ 'dren mchog bla ma kun gyi ngo bo nyid// ces sogs sam/ yang na/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// 'dren pa kun 'dus bla ma sogs dang*/ tshig rkang phyi ma gsum kun la 'gre ste/ === /yi dam kun 'dus= === /sangs rgyas kun 'dus= === /dam chos kun 'dus= === /dge 'dun kun 'dus= === /byang sems kun 'dus= === /nyan rang kun 'dus= === /chos skyong kun 'dus= === /nor lha kun 'dus= === /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid= === /ye shes lnga ldan= === /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin= === /don gnyis lhun grub= === /ma rig mun sel= === /thar pa'i lam ston= === /dgos 'dod kun 'byung= === /bsam 'phel nor bu= === /yid bzhin rin chen= === /dbang gi rgyal po= === /dran pas gdung sel= === /'gro ba'i 'dren pa= === /gcig chog rgyal po bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// zhes zhe thag pa nas gsol ba gdab bo// zhen pa spang ba ni/ gang la chags na nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// nyon mongs kyis bsags zas nor longs spyod kun// rje btsun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// rgyags dang ser sna zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// rang gi zhe sdang rang gzugs shar ba yi// gnod byed dgra 'drer snang ba ci mchis pa// rje btsun bla ma'i 'khor du dbul bar bgyi// zhe sdang dbyings su zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// ltar snang phan pas 'khor bar 'ching ba'i grogs// gnyen dang mdza' bshes 'khor g.yog la sogs pa// de kun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// 'dod chags rnam rtog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe rabs du mar grangs med mar byas kyang*// las nyon dbang gis gnyen ngo ma shes pa'i// bar ma'i 'gro rnams khyed la dbul bar bgyi// rmongs dang phrag dog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// rang lus phal par snang ba'i lag g.yas su// shes rab ral gri 'bar ba legs thogs te// tha mal lus su snang ba'i mgo bo yi// ya thod bcad nas mdun du bkan te bzhag

/gang de ches dkar yangs pa'i snod gyur par// rkang g.yon g.yas dang khog smad nang khrol dang*// khog stod lag g.yon mgo bo'i lhag ma dang*// lag pa ral gri bcas pa de nang bskyur// de la bsang sbyang byin rlabs rgyas par bya ba'am/ de tsam mi nus na/ oṃ las chos dbyings stong pa'i ngang nyid las// āḥlas ye shes thod pa cher yangs par// hūm̐ las sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga// hoḥlas dbyer med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// (oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum/ ) sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma rin po che// bdag gis mngon par bshams pa'i mchod pa 'di// bdag la brtse ba'i thugs kyis legs dgongs la// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes par mdzad du gsol// rang lus lha skur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas// yid 'phrog mchod pa'i lha mo mang spros pas// phyag gis thod pas bdud rtsi legs blangs nas// mchod yul rnams la phul te mchod par gyur// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhal du= /dges pa rdo rje'i= /brgyud pa'i bla ma'i= /yi dam lha tshogs= /sangs rgyas byang sems= (/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i=) /nyan thos rang rgyal= /chos srung nor lha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di// bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// mchod pa'i lha rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma yi// thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud zag med kyi// bde ba chen pos yongs su mnyes gyur te// mchog tu dges pa'i nyams dang ldan par gyur// bdud rtsi'i lhag ma rigs drug sems can rnams// lha ru gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// chags sdang rmongs gsum rnam rtog zhi ba dang*// byang chub sems 'byongs sangs rgyas thob gyur cig (/khyad par bdag la gnod byed gdon bgegs dang*// lan chags sha 'khon mgron rnams ma lus pa// tshim nas gdug pa'i bsam sbyor rab spang ste// sangs rgyas thob pa'i skal ba ldan gyur cig)

/rje btsun mchog gi mtha' skor bzhugs pa yi// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// nyan thos rang rgyal chos srung nor lha rnams// dbyings kyi rol pas bla ma'i thugs kar thim// dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po// oṃ gyi gzugs byung rang gi dpral bar thim// bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag /sku yis byin brlabs sprul sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po// āḥyi gzugs byung rang gi mgrin par thim// gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi dri ma dag /gsung gis byin brlabs longs sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po// hūm̐ gi gzugs byung rang gi snying gar thim// gsum pa'i dbang thob sems kyi dri ma dag /thugs kyis byin brlabs chos sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i yi ge gsum las 'od sna tshogs// 'bru gsum gzugs byung rang gi gnas gsum thim// bzhi pa'i dbang thob sgrib pa'i bag chags dag /kun gyis byin brlabs ngo bo nyid skur gyur/ (/bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa ni/ ) bla ma mchog dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i// gshis lugs brjod bral gsal snang ma 'gags pa// mos gus lam khyer phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*// bsgom bya sgom byed bral ba'i dbyings su bzhag / bla ma de rang sems dang dbyer med du gyur par bsams la/ lus bsam gtan gyi spyod lam bsgrim/ ngag rlung rang sor bzhag mig mdun gyi nam mkhar phyed btsum ran pas blta/ sems khong klod la dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul bcad de/ sems kyi gshis cir yang ma yin pa/ gdangs gang du'ang ma 'gag pa/ rtsal mos gus su dung nge ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i gsal le/ hrig ge ba/ stong sang nge ba'i ngang du ci nus shig bzhag la/

sangs rgyas kun 'dus phyi yi bla ma dang*// sems nyid 'od gsal nang gi bla ma dang*// rang bzhin spros bral don gyi bla ma gsum// dbyer med snying po'i bla ma rtogs par shog /dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams// dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma nyid// lhag pa'i lha ru shes pa'i mos gus kyis// dbang dang dngos grub rtag tu len par shog /lus ngag yid gsum longs spyod dang bcas pa'i// don yod rnam bzhis bla ma mnyes byas nas// ci mdzad rgyal ba'i mdzad pa legs rtogs te// rmad byung phrin las bsgrub la brtson par shog / ces brjod cing don yid la gtsogs par bya'o// de nas bla ma'i yon tan yid la dran pa dang*/ mdzad spyod kyi rjes su slob par 'dod pa dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba smon lam ci shes pa btab la/ chos dang mthun pa'i spyod lam gyis gnas par bya'o// 'di ni shin tu gsang ba'i 'os yin yang*// don gnyer slob mas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor// sbyar ba 'di la chos bdag mkha' 'gro yis// bzod pa mdzad de byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa nyams su blang bde ba'i phyir tshigs su bcad par byas pa zhig dgos so zhes rong po kun dga' bkra shis kyis nan chen pos bskul ba'i ngor/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rat+na war+dhā yab sras kyi bka' 'bangs su btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis lcags glang zla ba gsum pa'i nyer brgyad kyi nyin e wam̐ chos ldan du sbyar ba'i dge bas sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig /shin tu gsang bar bya'o// //( ) rtags pa 'di rnams mchog sprul rin po che'i zhal rgyun ltar bcug pa yin no// des ni 'dren mchog dpal ldan bla ma la// ma dad ma gus log par sgrub pa'i las// ma lus sbyangs nas bka' bzhin lhur len pa'i// rgyal sras rtag tu ngu dang mtshungs par shog

/deng nas brtsams te srid pa thams cad du// bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs pad gus bsten cing*// rnam mang yon tan tshogs kyis mnyes byed pa'i// nor bzang gzhon nu ji bzhin bdag gyur cig / tshar chen gyi gsung yin// // ༈ /rang skad cig gis dpal kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu la brgyan pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī he badz+ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ snying ga'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /

ces brjod// ༄༅// rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos man ngag kun gyi nying khu thugs dam nyams bzhes chag med rnam bzhir grags pa las bir srung phyi ma bzhugs// na mo gu ru bi rū pa pā dā ya/ bir srung thun mong ba'i nyams len ni/ skyabs sems spyi dang 'dra/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i gdan la rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i mthil gdan la brten cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub gyen du bstan pa/ sku 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ me tog sna tshogs kyis dbu rgyan dang do shal byas shing*/ pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ gus 'dud drag po dang ldan pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam la sngags kyi sgra grag stong la sems gtad nas/ ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu li/ badz+ra ka pā li/ badz+ra dhi na/ ban+dhu hā ra/ badz+ra pi aṃ/ hu tsang ge sa ra bhe ta na/ kha ge e/ aṃ ge mi li/

le ga par ta/ ta u la/ ti pā ṭa/ oṃ bi rū wa pa ra/ na mo bhe ta ni/ wa ra ṇa/ zhes pa tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ dam bca' bzhin du bzla/ mthar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i dngos// bla ma rnams dang dpal ldan bir+wa pa// gnyis su med la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// mgon po khyed kyi thugs dang bdag gi sems// dbye ba med par gcig tu 'dres gyur nas// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba khyed ci 'dra// bdag kyang de 'drar 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bla ma bir+wa pa de nyid rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis pad+ma dang zla ba ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i gdan la rang nyid rje btsun bir+wa pa sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i mthil gdan la brten cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub gyen du bstan pa/ sku 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ me tog sna tshogs kyis dbu rgyan dang do shal byas shing*/ pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin bskyed/ rang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bskyed rim gsal zhing nga rgyal brtan par/ rang gi lus kyi 'dug stangs kyang bi rū pa bsgoms pa dang 'dra bar byas te mig gnyis sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la gtad nas/ ngag gis rlung lan gcig bus shing phyir mnan/ sems kyis nad gdon sdig sgrib gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad mtha'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du bskrad par bsam/ rlung mi thub pa dang nang du dal bus bsdus nas/ bum pa can 'dzin dus phyi rol du me ri dmar nag gis yongs su bskor nas bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs par bsgom/ yang gong bzhin rlung bus shing phyir mnan/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa ste/

sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos/ rlung nang du bsdus nas bum pa can 'dzin dus/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur bla bre dang bcas pa'i thun mong ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i nang du/ rang rnal 'byor dbang phyug dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan pos gang la'ang nyam nga ba dang*/ bag tsha ba cung zad tsam yang med snyam pa'i bskyed rim rnam pa gsal zhing shin tu brten par bskyed/ de nas srung ba gnyis bsgom pa'i dang po rdo rje rtse gsum gyis bsrung ba ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan la/ sor mo gzhan gsum brkyangs pa dpral bar reg ste/ ak+ṣe bhi ma/ khar reg la/ pa tshe u pa ma/ snying gar reg la/ shi la pa tha ra/ lte bar reg la/ ha u a tshe u/ liṅgar reg la/ wa pa/ zhes yar rim dang*/ yang liṅgar reg la/ bir+wa/ lte bar reg la/ pa/ snying gar reg la/ pra/ khar reg la/ sa dheṃ/ dpral bar reg la/ swā hā/ sngags 'di rnams rlung gzung ba'i bar du brjod cing*/ swā hā'i rjes la phyag rgya bkrol te/ g.yon pas se gol brdab/ gnyis pa rnal 'byor bsrung ba la/ lus kyi 'dug stangs 'phags pa'i ltar/ rkang pa gnyis kyi brang sa la btsugs/ rting pa gnyis 'phongs la gtad/ pus mo gnyis phyir dgyel/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje phyir bsdoms pa las mthe bong gnyis/ gung mo gnyis/ mthe'u chung gnyis rnams rtse sprad pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ rlung bum pa can gyi ngang nas sngags rnams yid kyis zlos shing mthe bong gnyis snying gar reg la/ ak+ṣe bhi ma/ gung mo gnyis khar reg la/ pa tshe u pa ma/ mthe'u chung gnyis lte bar reg la/ shi la pa tha ra/ gung mo gnyis liṅgar reg la/ ha u a tshe u/ mthe'u chung gnyis bshang sgor reg la/ wa pa/ zhes yas rim dang*/ yang mthe'u chung gnyis slar bshang sgor reg la/

bir+wa/ gung mo gnyis liṅgar reg la/ pa/ mthe'u chung gnyis lte bar reg la/ pra/ mthe bong gnyis snying gar reg la/ sa dheṃ/ gung mo gnyis khar reg la/ swā hā/ zhes mas rim dang*/ yang gong bzhin snying ga nas bshang sgo'i bar phyag rgyas reg la/ ak+ṣe bhi ma nas/ wa pa 'i bar gyi sngags yid kyis zlos shing rlung btang la/ lag pa gnyis kyis se gol gtog par bya'o// de ltar rdzogs nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / ces bir srung phyi ma'i nyams len sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyi blo mtsho las so// //bkra shis// // ༄༅// bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len bya tshul bar chad g.yul rgyal bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan chos skyong dang*// gnyis min rigs kun khyab bdag drin can rjer// gus btud bir+wa'i thun min srung ba'i lam// zab mo'i ngag 'don mos ldan bskul ngor spel// 'dir gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i smin grol yongs rdzogs thob nas lam la slob par 'os pa'i gang zag gis srod dang tho rangs gang rigs su skyabs yul rnams gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs kyi skyabs 'gro rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lhar// gus pas skyabs gsol yid can rnams// byang chub thob par sems bskyed nas// 'khor mtsho'i dbyings las myur sgrol shog / ces dang*/ tshad med bzhi sogs sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i gdan gyi steng du pad+ma dang zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rang skad cig gis rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sdigs mdzub gyen du bstan pa'i rtse mo cung zad bkug pas nyi ma mnan pa/

g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu dpag bsam gyi shing bzang po la sku rgyab brten pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku shin tu grims pa/ zhal dang spyan bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing me tog sna tshogs kyis thod bcings pa/ de'i rgyab tu dpag bsam gyi shing bzang po/ mdun du tri shu la gyen du bgrengs ba la ḍā ma ru dpyangs pa/ g.yas su bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas brgyan pa/ g.yon du rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas gdugs 'dzin pa/ smin mtshams kyi thad kar srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan/ g.yas su ro ma/ g.yon du rkyang ma ste rtsa gsum bsam pa'i spyi bor ham̐/ mgrin par oṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar am̐/ gsang gnas su hā rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces pa/ pho brang lnga yi lha gsal gdab/ dkyil 'khor lnga la btud de bskrun// ces pa'i don rnams so// de nas rlung kha sbyor du bya ba ni/ srog rtsol 'gog pa'i sbyor ba yis// zhes pa'i don te/ de nas rlung bum pa can bzung nas/ rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i bshang sgo'i rlung gis lte ba'i me sbar/ g.yas ro ma'i nang nas zhugs/ 'khor lo rnams mas rim gyis gsal btab/ me de spyi bo'i ham̐ la reg pas/ de las byang chub kyi sems g.yon rkyang ma nas babs/ 'khor lo rnams yas rim gyis gsal btab pa'i mthar/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung dang byang chub kyi sems rnams dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te/ rlung sems thig le thams cad dbu mar thim par bsgoms la bum can thub tshad du bya ste/ 'bar g.yo brtan pa la brten nas// zhes pa'i don to// de ltar rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pas/ bde stong zung 'jug gi nyams skye bar 'gyur te/

bde chen chos sku'i nam mkha' mthong*// zhes pa'i don to// de ltar rlung sbyor mang du byas pa'i mthar/ lus kyi 'dug stangs kyang bir+wa pa bzhin bya ste/ lag pa g.yas pa sdigs mdzub byas pa'i rtse mo cung zad bkug la/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin tshul thugs kar khu tshur kha gyen bstan/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs byas la/ ngag gis rlung lan gcig bus shing phyir mnan/ rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dang*// gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba'i// 'byung po mi dang mi min kun// rgya mtsho'i phar mthar bskrad par gyur// ces brjod la/ rlung mi thub pa dang nang du dal bus bsdus nas/ bum pa can 'dzin dus/ de phyir me ri rab 'bar bas// bar chad g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur// zhes brjod la/ gong bzhin rlung bus shing phyir mnan/ nyon shes sdig sgrib bag chags kun// ma lus byang zhing dag par gyur// zhes brjod la/ rlung nang du bsdus nas bum pa can 'dzin dus/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa drwa la// gur dang bla bre srung 'khor phyir// me dpung rab 'bar de dbus su// rang nyid rnal 'byor dbang phyug gyur// de nas srung ba gnyis bsgom pa'i dang po rdo rje rtse gsum gyis bsrung ba ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan la/ sor mo gzhan gsum brkyang pa dpral bar reg ste/ ak+ṣe bhi ma/ khar reg la/ pa tshe u pa ma/ snying gar reg la/ shi pa la tha ra/ lte bar reg la/ ha u a tshe u/ liṅgar reg la/ wa pa/ zhes yas rim dang*/ yang liṅgar reg la/ bir+wa/ lte bar reg la/ pa/ snying gar reg la/ pra/ khar reg la/ sa dheṃ/ dpral bar reg la/ swā hā/ sngags 'di rnams rlung bzung ba'i bar du brjod cing*/ swā hā'i rjes la phyag rgya bkrol te/ g.yon pas se gol brdab/ gnyis pa rnal 'byor bsrung ba la/ lus kyi 'dug stangs 'phags pa ltar/ rkang pa gnyis kyi brang sa la btsugs/ rting pa gnyis 'phongs la gtad/ pus mo gnyis phyir dgyel/
