/ces smon lam btab/ rang nyid kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas srung ba byas la/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i// lus can kun gyis bsod nams ye shes tshogs// myur du bsgrub nas tshe 'di kho na la// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can kun// bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur te// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob bar// skye dang skye bar gnas bzang po// rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang*// grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la sgrin// rnam par dag cing rgyu gcig pa// bskal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan te// thos nas gzhan la ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang*// lag pas thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin// ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas// yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog /'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing*// bsgrub la bar chad med pa dang*// bstan la bya ba byed par shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bkra shis ni/ mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma brgyud par bcas// mtshan nas brjod dam cung zad dran yang rung*// bkra shis 'phel phyir rtag tu dran par 'gyur// pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i steng na brjid// yon tan mtha' yas ye shes lnga yi dngos// he ru ka dpal bdag med rnal 'byor ma// bkra shis des ni skye dgu bde legs shog

/sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ sogs dang*/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// sogs dang*/ tshangs dang brgya byin rgyal po chen po bzhi// rang rang sder bcas mthu dang dpal ldan pa// ston pa'i dam chos skyong bar mdzad pa yi// lha yi dge bsnyen rnams kyi bkra shis shog /gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab bcom nas// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sogs/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan// sogs/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyis bkra shis shog /ces brjod// ༈ //spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis yul dang yul can thams cad lha'i 'khor lor shes par byas la sdang zhen med par longs spyad/ kha zas za ba'i tshe kha zas la lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas bza' btung bdud rtsir bsams la/ snying ga'i hūm̐ lha thams cad kyi ngo bor mchod par mos shing chags zhen med par bza'/ lhag ma/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ zhes se gol gyi sgra dang bcas te lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin/ khyim pa yin na 'du shes gsum ldan gyi sgo nas rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor bya/ nyal ba'i tshe/ yum yab la/ yab kyi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la/ de thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la/ khog pa mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ mthar nā da yang mi dmigs par bsams la 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i ngang du nyal/ tho rangs gnyid sad pa na chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul gyis lha'i nga rgyal gyis langs la/ srod thun gyi rjes kyi rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis smon lam rnams bya/

khrus byed na dbang gi skabs ji lta ba bzhin nam/ rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyis ngag tu yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing bkrus la/ mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor logs nas 'byung ba ltar byas te tho rangs kyi thun la 'jug pa sogs gong bzhin du bya'o// ༈ //dbang 'bring po len na/ mchod bstod gsol btab byas mthar/ 'di de sangs rgyas dmas cad de// sogs nas/ 'bras bu sprul sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes gsung zhing rig pa'i dbang lnga/ brtul zhugs dam tshig gsum dang bcas par bskur bar bsams la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs nas/ dbang bskur ro// de ltar na rdzas gsang sogs nas/ longs sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag dga' ster gnas ster sogs nas/ mchod pa dag tu gyis/ de ltar na phyag rgya'i sogs nas/ chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag ye shes 'di ni sogs nas/ de yi pha zhes gsungs pas gong du smos pa lta bu'i dbang bzhi pa'i rtogs pa skyes par bsams la/ de ltar na don dam sogs nas/ ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag ces pa'i mthar/ de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des zhes sogs gong bzhin brjod do// ༈ //dbang bsdus pa ni/ gong gi ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥs dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bar sngar bzhin la/ de nas/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum bzhi/ sogs nas/ sa mā dzāḥ dkar mo ri dwags sogs mchod/ spro na/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// sogs nas/ bdag dges mdzod// ces bstod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa/ sogs nas/ dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur nas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba thogs te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// sogs nas/ chen po sbyin/ oṃ badz+rī nas hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dbang bskur/

rig ma rnams sogs nas/ chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ sogs nas/ yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon/ dbang gi chu rgyun des mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo am̐ las kyi phyag rgya/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo hūm̐ chos kyi phyag rgya/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo oṃ phyag rgya chen po/ spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lo ham̐ dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ dbang gi chu rgyun des snying ga yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma/ dbang gi chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ sogs nas/ ḍom+bhi nī la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba nas/ ko3haṃ/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs man sngar dang 'dra'o// de ltar na rnal 'byor rnam pa bcu bar ma chad par nyams su blangs na gnas skabs su grub mtha' rnams rim pas snyogs shing*/ mthar thug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// khams drug yul drug 'gro drug dbang po drug /kha dog drug dang phung po dbyings bcas drug /sbyangs nas rgyal ba rigs drug thob byed pa'i// sgrub thabs 'di ni yan lag drug pa yin// de yi ngag 'don mngon rtogs mdzes rgyan 'di// blo ldan slob ma mang pos bskul ba'i ngor// rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la gtugs te// 'dren mchog bla ma'i dgongs pa ji bzhin bkod// sngags rnams phal cher rgya dpe du ma la// gtugs te shin tu dag par bgyis pas na// ring thung gcod mtshams 'di bzhin shes gyis la// dpyod ldan rnams kyis dag par nyams su long*// bdag gis 'bad de legs par dpyad na yang*// zab don 'byed la byis blo mthu chung bas// nongs pa mchis na bla ma lhar bcas kyis// bzod pa mdzad de sdig kun sbyang du gsol// 'dir 'bad dge dang dge gzhan ci mchis des// 'dren mchog bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*// mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// bdag gis bla med byang chub myur thob shog

/dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'bring du bya ba yan lag drug pa'i mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur pa 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po rat+na war+dha'i zhal snga nas dang*/ tshad med thugs rje'i mnga' bdag mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen dang*/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa lo tsā ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs chen po la sogs pa yongs 'dzin dam pa sprul pa'i sku du ma'i zhabs kyi rdul phreng rnyog pa med pa'i gtsug gis blangs pa la brten nas/ 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi gsung rab rin po che rnams kyi tshig don la shes nas dad pa thob pa/ mang du thos pa'i btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis las dang po pa rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du/ mus chen sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi yi ge la gzhi byas/ rje btsun gong ma yab sras kyi gsung rab rnams la zhus dag gi tshul du gtugs shing*/ bla ma mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung sgros kyis kyang brgyan te/ lcags mo phag gi lo ston zla 'bring po'i yar tshes bcu'i nyin/ rje bla ma yab sras gsum gyi dus dran gyi mchod par dmigs te/ dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba dge legs mchog tu gyur cig 'di'i rgyab rten du dpal sa skya pa yab sras kyi gsung rab rnams rtog dpyod zhib mos blta ba gal che'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// //

༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi nā+e ye/ de la 'dir dbang thob cing byin rlabs zab mo'i rgyud smin pa'i gang zag gis/ bsdus pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs yul gsal btab nas/ bdag sogs 'gro kun deng nas byang chub bar// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// rdzogs byang go 'phang la brten sems can kun// bsgral phyir zab mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad zlar rdo rje sems// rab dkar rdor rje dril 'dzin snyems ma dkar// gri thod 'dzin pa'i yum dang mnyam par sbyor// dar dang rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs// yab kyi thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ dkar po// de las 'od 'phros de bzhin gshegs kun gyi// byin rlabs ye shes bdud rtsi spyan drangs thim// bla ma bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yis// bdag sogs 'gro kun sdig ltung sbyang mdzad gsol// hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang nyid kyi// spyi gtsug nas zhugs nad gdon sdig sgrib kun// yongs su sbyangs te lus kun gang bar gyur// zhes brjod stobs bzhi'i gnad dang bcas/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus mthar/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// gsang gsum rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig nyams chags mthol zhing bshags// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs// ma lus byang zhing dag mdzad gsol// rdor sems 'od zhu rang la thim// rang lus dag pa'i shel ltar bsam// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/

mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes gzhal med khang*// de dbus seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// dmar gsal rdo rje dril 'dzin longs sku'i chas// mthar bskor pad zlar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam par bzhugs// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las// 'od 'phros skyabs yul thams cad spyan drangs thim// skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur// skyabs kun 'dus zhal rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mos gus drag pos gsol btab nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i/ lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod par bsam/ phyi mchod nyer spyod nang mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin// gsang ba snyoms 'jug bde stong de kho na// 'khor gsum dmigs med phyag rgya chen po yis// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams mchod par bgyi// khyad par nang gi tshogs mchod ni/ rang sems rnal 'byor ma dpal mkha' la thon// phyag g.yas gri gug phung po'i smin mtshams su// reg pa tsam gyis thod pa ling gis gog /thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi khar bzhag la// stong gsum dang mnyam yangs pa'i snod gyur nang*// rkang g.yon nas brtsams dum bur gtub ste blugs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha ho hrīḥbarjod pas// ye shes me 'bar thod pa'i dam rdzas kun// zhu zhing khol bas ye shes bdud rtsir gyur// thugs nas sprul pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// lan bdun/ brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang mchod 'os zhal du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gdon bgegs rigs drug 'gro ba kun la sbyin// tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang rnam mkhyen myur thob shog /mthar ni lha mo rang la thim/ mchod pa'i rdzas sogs mi dmigs bzhag spro na maṇ+ḍal ci nus 'bul/ mjug tu dbang bzhi blang ba ni/

sangs rgyas kun dngos dpal ldan bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi bskur du gsol// zhes pas gsol btab brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i thugs kar dbyer med thim// de yi gnas gsum rdo rje'i 'bru gsum las// dkar dmar mthing kha'i 'od zer rnam pa gsum// rim dang gcig car byung nas rang nyid kyi// gnas gsum thim pas dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob// sgrib dag lam bzhi bsgom pa'i snod du gyur// byin rlabs sku bzhi'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag /bla ma 'od zhu snying dbus bam̐ yig dang*// dbyer med spros bral 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ngang*// mthar ni bam̐ yig 'ja' tshon bzhin du yal// de yi ngang las snying gar e e las// chos 'byung zla dkyil dbus su bam̐ yig mthar// sngags 'phreng 'khor ba'i zil gyis gzhi lus sbyangs// 'od kyi phung por gyur las skad cig gis// rang nyid pad nyid dus mtshan 'jigs byed steng*// rnam snang rigs bdag bcas pa'i rnal 'byor ma// dmar gsal spyan gsum nam mkha'i dbyings su gzigs// phyag g.yas gri gug thur du brkyang nas 'dzin// g.yon pas thog khrag steng phyogs bzung bas gsol// phrag pa g.yon par rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ bsten// thod skam dbu rgyan do shal phyag rgyas spras// zhabs zung g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dor thabs bzheng*// bde chen nyams 'bar ye shes me dbus rol// thugs srog 'od kyi snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs// rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing skur lam gyis gsal// 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ phaiṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas// lhan skyes zhing sngags rnal 'byor ma dpal kun// tshur 'dus dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥrang la thim// dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par gyur// ye shes gzhug pa'i rkyen gyis snying ga'i bam̐// 'od zhu dbus su mkha' spyod dmar po dang*// byang nas g.yon bskor ljang dmar ser dang dkar// mtha' bskor sngags kyi yig 'bru so gnyis kyang*// rnal 'byor ma dpal dmar po re re gyur// de nas/

oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dha rmā yo ga shud+dhā&haṃḥ lus gnas so sor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// ngo bo lha la rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs// oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hrīṃ mam̐ yo ga shud+dho3 ham̐ḥ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa rnams kyis mtshan pa yi// lus dkyil gtso mo'i thugs kar chos 'byung dbus// zla steng bam̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor// 'phros pa'i 'od kyis 'phags mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs// pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs nus mthu kun// bsdus thim mkha' spyod dngos grub thob par gyur// oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dam bcas grangs las ma nyung ba bzla/ yid bzlas skabs su snying ga yi// lus dkyil lte bar drangs pa dang*// lhan cig lha rnams sngags su bsgyur// sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul gyis bzla// de nas/ bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// 'gro kun mkha' spyod 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// khams gsum 'od zhu rang dang rang nyid kyang*// nā da'i bar thim 'od gsal dbyings su yal// slar yang rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa yi// lha sku go chas mtshan par gsal ba'i ngang*// snang grags rtog tshogs lha sngags chos kyi sku// dga' ba gsum dang dbyer med 'dres par gyur// dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang 'grub gyur nas// srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa kun sel zhing*// don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /bzhi pa thun mong ma yin pa'i/ bsam mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ zhar byung rdzogs rim bsgoms pa'i mthar// lus gnas bsrang zhing rlung ro bsal// rang gi lus dbus rtsa dbu ma// phyi dkar nang dmar spyi gtsug zug /g.yas g.yon ro rkyang dkar dang dmar// yar sna sna bug gnyis su gug /rtsa gsum mar sna lte ba'i 'og /sbubs stong gcig tu gyur pa'i dbus// bam̐ yig rang sems dbyer med pa// rnal 'byor ma dpal mtheb sor tshad// gsol btab de la sems gtad pas// rlung phyir 'gro dang lhan cig tu// thugs las rang 'dra chung ngu 'phros// ro ma'i lam brgyud sna g.yas sgor// byon nas de las sprul pa'i tshogs// dpag med nyi zer rdul bzhin 'phros// 'phags mchog 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs// rnal 'byor ma gyur tshur 'dus pa// sprul pa'i rnal 'byor ma la thim// de nyid sna bug g.yon nas rlung*// nang du 'jug dang lhan cig par// rkyang ma'i lam brgyud lte ba yi// rnal 'byor ma la thim par bsam// de ltar lan bdun la sogs pas// rtsa lam sbyangs nas dngos gzhi ni// lte bar rang sems rnal 'byor ma'i// thugs las 'od 'phros lus kun gang*// 'od phung dmar po gcig tu gyur// rnal 'byor ma yang mkha' spyod la// 'byon par ring pas yar byon te// dbu ma dbu gtsug ro rkyang gnyis// zhabs mthil la 'byar je thung gyur// spyi bor byon tshe rtsa gsum dang*// lus kun lhag ma med par thim// rnal 'byor ma dpal mkha' spyod gshegs// 'od gsal dbyings su thim par bsam// bsam gyis mi khyab ngang du bzhag

/slar yang rang sems rnal 'byor ma// mkha' las sprin ltar brdol nas kyang*// mar byon gzhi lus sngar bzhin grub// slar yang 'pho sogs ci nus sbyangs// mthar ni go cha 'god pa sogs// gzhung ltar nyams su blang bar bya// gsungs pa gong gi nyer bsdu'i mtshams// slar yang rgyan dang phyag mtshan spang pa yi// lha sku go chas mtshan sogs gong ltar bya// khyad par gdams pa 'di rnams ni// man ngag thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas// tshul bzhin nyams su bstar ba na// mkha' spyod go 'phang tshe 'dir 'grub// de ltar rang gis sngon sbyar ba'i// sgrub thabs mkha' spyod lam bzang dang*// rjes su 'brel ba'i gdams pa 'di// mang du thos pa'i spong ba pa// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po yi// dam pa gong ma'i gsung bzhin du// mdor bsdus tshigs bcad phreng bar bstebs// dge bas yid can rgya mtsho kun// mkha' spyod chen po myur 'grub shog / sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs nges don thig le bzhugs so// ༈ na maḥs man+ta bha dra ya/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs/ kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems dpa'i dpal// pad+ma 'byung gnas klu yi dbang po dang*// rdo rje rin chen shes rab rin chen dang*// tshul khrims rgyal po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje gtsug tor dge skyabs dge mthong dang*// 'khon ston bal po shakyā blo gros mtshan// shes rab tshul khrims dkon mchog rgyal po'i zhabs// kun dga' snying po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan dang*// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// 'od ldan dpal dang kun dga' rdo rje dang*// legs pa'i blo gros rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kun dga' bsod nams rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*// bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims pa// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dang grags pa'i zhabs// glo bo mkhan chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sa skya lo tsā sngags 'chang chen po dang*// bsod nams dbang po 'jam mgon a me'i zhabs// bsod nams dbang phyug kun dga' bkris dang*// bsod nams rin chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sa chen kun blo dbang sdud snying po dang*// pad+ma bdud 'dul dbang phyug maṅga la// kun dga' snying po karma rat+na dang*// kun dga' rin chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// blo gros snying po gzhan phan snying po dang*// ngag dbang kun dga' bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rnam gsum ting nge 'dzin la legs gnas nas// dkyil 'khor gsum bsgom mchod pa gsum gyis mchod// dri ma gsum sbyangs sku gsum mngon gyur te// sa gsum skye dgu'i dpal du bdag gyur cig

/skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog// / ༄༅// na mo badz+ra kī la ya/ 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i sku// bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu la// btud nas de yi sgrub thabs bri// bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi// sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa ni// 'khrul zad sngags 'chang yab sras kyi// phyag len mdzad pa 'di ltar ro// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gi bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig byams pa/ /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog snying rje/ /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*/ dga' ba/ /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog btang snyoms// oṃ mahā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ ni sngags kyi mgo 'dren pa/ nye tshe ba ma yin pa'i stong pa chen po/ ye shes rang gi sems/ rdo rje de'i ngang du gnas pas rang bzhin/ bdag nyid nga'o// de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ oṃ dharmā dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ chos rnams kyi dbyings rdo rje bdag nyid can gyi rang bzhin de nga'o// rdo rje chos nyid don gyi rdo rje de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ khro bos zhe sdang gcod/ mtshan ma dang rnam rtog la 'phros pas zhe sdang gtso bor gyur pa'i nyon mongs gcod pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar/ ye shes lnga mtshon pa'i hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer 'bar ba rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang*/

'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i bskyed gzhir shar ba/ /snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ hūm̐ rjes su mar babs nas snying gar sems dpa' gsum brtseg bsgom/ /hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ// hūm̐ las raṃ chad snod bcud 'jig rten bsreg /yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor// khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus// skyon thams cad dag par byas// e yaṃ waṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ keṃ e s+pha ra phaṭ// hūm̐ las yi ge de dag 'phros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur// e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ gru gsum mthing skya/ /yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ zlum po ljang gu zur nas bltas na gzhu 'dra ba/ /de steng waṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ dkar po zlum po/ /raṃ las me byung bskyod pa de yi phyed/ gru gsum dmar po/ /laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ gru bzhi ser po/ /de steng rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug raṃ las khrag gi rgya mtsho/ /dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng*/ keng las keng rus kyi ri rab/ gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras/ e las chos 'byung*/ dzaḥpaṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ mahā de wa dzaḥ u ma de wī dzaḥ pad+ma nyi ma zla ba/ dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi g.yas su dbang phyug kha sbubs/ g.yon du u ma gan rgyal/

gyi steng du/ rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de babs pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis sangs rgyas byang sems rnams mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyangs pa sogs/ byas tshur gzhi'i hūm̐ la/ 'dus te 'od du zhu nas rang rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī li ya sarba bigh+nān bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭ/ lan gsum/ hūm̐/ gdan steng bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal// bcom ldan rdo rje dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje'o/ /skye 'chi bgres rgud med pas gzhon nu'i sku// mthing nag zhal gsum sku gsum mtshon/ phyag drug pa/ phar phyin drug mtshon/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal// rdo rje rtse dgu ye shes dgus sa dgu man gyi rtog sgrib sbyong ba/ rtse lnga dang*/ 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyong zhing sku lnga ye shes lnga la sbyor ba/ 'khor ba'i nyon mongs bsregs pas /me dpung 'bar ba dug gsum bcad nas sku gsum la sbyor bas/ rtse gsum rnams// g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gis bsnams// thabs shes gnyis med sgo nas dgra bgegs la gzir bas/ mtha' gnyis phur 'dril sku che rags// skye gnas bzhi sbyang phyir /mche ba bzhi gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ g.yas kyi spyan gsum chos dbyings la gzigs pa/ g.yon gyi spyan gsum sems can la gzigs pa/ dbus kyi spyan gsum 'khor 'das mnyam nyid la gzigs pa'o/ /log lta'i 'gro ba dbyings su 'dren pas /ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes// gti mug can 'dul ba dang stobs bcu rdzogs pa'i rtags /glang lpags 'dod chags can 'dul ba dang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rtags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol// zhe sdang can sogs 'dul dka' ba 'dul ba la mchog tu dpa' ba'i rtags

stag gi pags pa'i 'og pags can// klu rigs bzhi dbang du sdud pa dang 'phrin las bzhi mthar phyin pa'i rtags su sbrul dkar khras dbu rgyan/ dmar khras mgul rgyan/ ljang khras rked bcing*/ nag khras phyag zhabs dpung pa rnams brgyan pa dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan// dbu rgyan se ral rked bcings dang*// phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras// chos sku skyon dang bral ba'i rtags thod skam lnga yis dbu la rgyan/ rigs lnga mtshon/ / dregs pa zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas// rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyi// thig le zo ris tshom bu bris/ pa ste/ thugs rjes sems can la chags pa'i rtags mkhur tshos g.yas g.yon la/ rak+ta ste khrag gi thig le/ don dam bcud kyi brgyan pa'i rtags nu ma gnyis bar zhag gi zo ris zla ba phyed pa dang 'dra ba dang*/ mtshan ma'i spros pa med pa'i rtags su skra mtshams su thal chen gyi tshom bu bris/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ gser la sogs pa rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs mdzes par spras pa'o// bsdu dngos bzhi mtshon pas zhabs bzhi zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas/ dbang phyug kha sbub mgo bo dang*// u ma'i nu ma rab tu brdzis// ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ zhabs g.yas gnyis bskum pas dbang phyug kha sbub tu yod pa'i mgo bo brdzis pas rtag pa'i mtha' mnan pa/ g.yon gnyis brkyangs nas chad pa'i mtha' mnan pa'i phyir u ma gan rgyal du yod pa'i nu ma'i steng brdzis pa/ sprul pa du ma 'gyed pa'i rtags su sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ ljags dmar po glog ltar 'khyug pa/ snyan dang shangs nas dus kyi 'thor rlung 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir ba ltar sgrog zhal nam mkha' ltar gdangs pa/ thabs shes rab kyi rang bzhin rdo rje khyung gshog nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/

rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched skra// nyi khri chig stong ba spu bye ba phrag /phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyang*// rdo rje gzhon nu rang dang 'dra bas go mtshams med pas gtams par gyur/ / chos la dmigs pa'i snying rjes rang tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog las bsgral te bdag dang lha'i skur bskyed/ ba'i dam tshig ni/ lha bsgom pa las mi 'da' ba'o // nga rgyal gyis bsad zhe sdang gis bcings gti mug gis mnan pa nyid min te// phung po rdo rje'i bdag nyid de phung khams skye mched lha'i bdag nyid du bsgom // rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' bsgom pa ste/ thugs kar gzhal yas khang zlum po sgo gcig pa/ sgo srung rta mgrin yum bzhi dang bcas/ nang du nyi gdan la ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba'i tshogs rgyal ba'i thugs ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba bsgom/ bh+rūm̐ bi ma na mahā sūr+ya dz+nyā na sa twa kṛṣ+ṇa shu ka pañtsa badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dip+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo dbyings las ma g.yos pas sngo sang*// chos kun ro gcig pas zhal gcig bden pa gnyis mtshon pas phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs// thugs rje glog ltar myur ba'i rtags gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lngas dbu la brgyan// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// skam po lnga bcus do shal byas/ sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyi// thig le zo ris tshom bur byas// thabs shes kyi rang bzhin zhabs gnyis g.yas zhabs g.yas thugs rje chen pos sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i rtags su brkyang pa/

g.yon brkyangs bskum gyis/ g.yon shes rab rtogs pa'i brdar bskum pa/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud par bzhugs// rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin rnams// 'khor ba rdo rje grub par mdzod// oṃ s+pha ra na phaṭ/ 'od zer phar 'phros/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ tshur bsdus rang la thim pas snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gyur/ 'khor ba rdo rje phur pa'i lha// ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra sa ma dzaḥ sa ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ni hūm̐ dzaḥ sa gnod sbyin mo mdog dkar pu shud mgo can lcags skyu dang phur pa thogs pas ye shes pa rnams smin mtshams su 'gugs/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra be hūm̐ hūm̐/ gis 'jigs byed ma ser mo bya rog mgo can zhags pa dang phur bu thogs pas ye shes pa rnams rang la zhugs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ gyis bdud rtsi ma mdog dmar srin bya'i mgo can lcags sgrogs dang phur bu thogs pas dbyer med du byas/ oṃ badz+ra ma ra ṇi hūm̐ hoḥ sa gsod byed ma ljang gu khwa'i mgo can dril bu dang phur bu thogs pas dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor byas par bsam mo// rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam pa de la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs bstims nas byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las// chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// sku yi gter du bdag bskyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung*// rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las// chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// gsung gi gter du bdag skyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes thugs// rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las// chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// thugs kyi gter du bdag skyed cig

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dbang lha khro bo rigs lnga spyan drangs/ thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod// dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig / dbu gtsug tu rigs lnga'i khro bos dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhī shwa ri hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha kro dhī shwa ri oṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro dhī shwa ri trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhī shwa ri hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri aḥ dbang bskur bas/ hūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na kī li kī la ya dz+nyā na sa twa e tri kro nā bi ma naḥ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ hūm̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭ/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du// dbang phyug u ma bsnol ba'i gdan steng na// bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni// sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan// yab yum thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med// 'khor gyi phra men pho nya'i tshogs la sogs// yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha// drag po rang 'byung dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bighā nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭ/ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ dip+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes ci rigs dang*/ mahā rak+moḥ yak+moḥ kā la ru pa/ snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃḥ srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃḥ snying la khril khrilaḥ srog la chum chum/ tsit+ta srog la tuṃ tuṃ/ thum ril ril/ snying khrag srog la shan shānaḥ snying tsheg tshegaḥ 'ur 'uraḥ shig shigaḥ gul gulaḥ nyag nyagaḥ gsod gsodaḥ dha ti ma ma shrī ghaṃ karma ka ra ma ra se na pra mar dha ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang nyid bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun// sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*// kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol// ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// 'khor lo rab bskor zhi khro'i skur bstan pa// thugs dam dbang gis bdag la rtser dgongs nas// drag po'i stobs kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// he ru ka'i yig brgya tshar gsum/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra kro dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra ka wa tsi hūm̐ phaṭ/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun// bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas// rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi// 'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /skye med chos sku rang bzhin rnam dag las// thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi skur sprul pa// bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi// skye 'chi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog / ces dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa sa lo sngags 'chang yab sras kyi dgongs pa 'khrul med 'di sa skya pa kun blos yon tan rgya mtsho'i don du bris pa dge'o// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// tshogs bshad brgyud 'debs// ༈ rnam dag dkyil 'khor bzhi yi 'dzin ma la// rnam dkar dbang bzhi'i char rgyun legs phab nas// rnam grol sku bzhi'i lo tog rgyas mdzad pa// rnam mkhyen bla ma bzhi la gsol ba 'debs// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang bdag med ma// mthu stobs dbang phyug grub chen nag po pa// ḍā ma rū pa a wa dhū tī pa// ga ya dha ra rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar dpal ldan sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// bud+dhā shrī dang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// sems dpa' chen po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seng*// dkon mchog 'phel dang sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs// sa skya lo tsā dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// kun dga' rin chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog rgya mtsho bsod nams dbang po dang*// grags pa blo gros sangs rgyas rgyalamatshan zhabs// kun dga' bsod nams bsod nams dbang phyug dang*// kun dga' bkra shis rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams rin chen sa chen kun blo'i zhabs// kun dga' bkra shis pad+ma bdud 'dul dbang*// kun dga' rgyal mtshan bkra shis rin chen zhabs// kun dga' snying po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje 'chang dngos karma rat+na dang*// rigs kun khyab bdag gzhan phan snying po'i zhabs// 'khor lo'i mgon po 'jam dpal bzang po sogs// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'og min chos dbyings rdo rje'i pho brang du// zab gsang snyan brgyud dam pa'i mdzod bzung nas// skal ldan 'gro rnams smin cing grol mdzad pa'i// 'dren mchog dbang gi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs//

sh+lau ka bse ru ngor klu lding mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzad pa'o// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin brlabs kyis// nges 'byung byang chub sems gnyis snying la shar// 'bras bu'i yon tan thob pas yid spro ste// gsang chen lam la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// bskyed pa phyi dbyibs rdul tshon dkyil 'khor du// bum pa'i dbang bskur bskyed rim lam bsgoms pas// rtsa yi 'gros kyis lus kyi sgrib sbyangs nas// sprul sku'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// bha ga byang sems nang gi dkyil 'khor du// gsang ba'i dbang bskur gtum mo'i lam bsgoms pas// yi ge'i 'gros kyis ngag gi sgrib sbyangs nas// longs sku'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// kun rdzob byang sems gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du// gsum pa'i dbang bskur pho nya'i lam bsgoms pas// bdud rtsi'i 'gros kyis yid kyi sgrib sbyangs nas// chos sku'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// don dam byang sems mthar thug dkyil 'khor du// bzhi pa'i dbang bskur rba rlabs lam bsgoms pas// rlung gi 'gros kyis sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs nas// ngo bo nyid sku thob par byin gyis rlobs// gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i gzhung 'di ni shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o//

de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du// mthun rkyen rgyal bas bsngags pa kun tshang nas// bsam don chos dang mthun pa legs 'grub ste// srid zhi'i phun tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / ces 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa 'di'ang sbrel na legs so// thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// yon tan me tog tshul khrims bdug spos sprin// shes rab sgron me dad pa spos chu'i mtsho// ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zhal zas dam pa dang*// bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan sgra 'byin cing*// kun nas snying brtse rnam dpyod spobs pa yi// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng ba yis// bdag lus gzhal med khang brtsegs rab brgyan nas// snying ga'i chu skyes thig le zla rgyas la// brtan par bzhugs pa'i chos rje mchod bgyid cing*// nges par 'dun pa'i yid kyis gsol btab pas// 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'o// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog/ // dge'o// ༄༅// kyai rdor lam dus ma nor don gsal bzhugs// ༈ na mo gu ru we/ dpal kyai rdo rje gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs la lus dkyil dang lam dus kyi dbang sbyar ba'i ngag 'don ni/ skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/

bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/

sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ ces ci nus kyi mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ rang skad cig gis dpal kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu la brgyan pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ namaḥshrī he badz+ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ snying ga'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma ri ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces lan gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig

nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod/ chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi snang ba/ de'ang rang rig pa sgyu ma lta bu/ de'ang rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du shes par byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang am̐ las thod pa dang gri gu hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa las rang nyid dpal kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal ka drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbur brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid// de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib ma rdo rje'i rwa ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ sen mo me ri 'bar ba ste srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga bzhi sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa re khā/ sna rin po che'i pha gu/ so drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta babs/ rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dabs drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte ba'i ām̐/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

yum sa rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gsang gnas bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i hā/ phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das phrin las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rlung rnam par dag pa dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo so gnyis kyis bskor ba bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba'i hūm̐/ zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum chu rnam par dag pa mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte ba'i oṃ/ 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum me rnam par dag pa gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo bcu drug gis bskor ba so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte ba'i haṃ/

gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum dang 'dra ba'i lha mo so gnyis kyis bskor ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gtso bo lnga po thams cad dbu'i gtsug tor blta bar mi mngon pa la sogs pa mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ sen po zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba la sogs dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ gzhan yang mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lcer 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang gu/ snying khar bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de dag gi mdun du zhal nang la phyogs pa'i tshul gyis mig tu gzugs gau ri/ rna bar sgra tsau rī/ snar dri be ta lī/ lcer ro ghasma rī/ dpral bar reg sa spyod ma/ snying gar chos khams mkha' spyod ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lag pa g.yas par gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon par shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ lcer pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas su bgegs mthar byed sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon par 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/

g.yon par stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ lha de thams cad kyang sku dbyibs/ rnam pa bde ba/ rang bzhin stong gsal/ ngo bo zung 'jug gzhan yang lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos kyi sku/ snying po ye shes rlung ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pa// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces pas mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes pas gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lha rigs lnga'i phyag na bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣ-iñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/

lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ des chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag yang de dag gis rin po che'i cod paṇa mgo la bcing nas dbang bskur bar mos la/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra rā ga ta badz+ra sha li hoḥ des cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag yang de dag gis lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin nas dbang bskur bar mos la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs// des rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag yang de dag gis lag pa g.yon par dril bu byin nas dbang bskur bar mos la/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ des dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag yang de dag gis ming gi dbang bskur bar mos la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣi ka ta kye/ dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// des ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag yang de dag gis lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// lag pa g.yon du dril bu byin nas/

'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// dril bu'i sgra kun rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// lag pa gnyis kas 'khyud rgya byas la/ dbang lhas/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs ni bsdu bar gyis// zhes gsungs pas dam tshig gsum thob par bsam/ yang de dag gis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob par bsam/ de ltar na bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// gsang dbang ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bor mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mchod la/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga po mi bskyod pa'i rnam par bsdus/ mi bskyod pa thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems mu tig gi rdog ma lta bu bdag gi lce thog la bzhag par bsams la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// thig le de mgrin pa nas 'phel te lus thams cad gang bas rlung nang du ldog cing rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa rags rim 'gag par bsam/

de ltar na rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa li bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag sher dbang ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces mchod/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mi bskyod pa'i yum las mā ma kī gcig bye ba/ bdag la gtad nas dbang lhas/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis// zhes gsungs par bsam/ rig ma de bdag nyid kyi yum la thim nas/ de dang snyoms par zhugs pas yas 'bab dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong bar bsam/ de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag dbang bzhi pa ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod// 'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// ces mchod/

mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang*// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// bzhi pa yang ni byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dbang gi lhas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes gsung par bsams la/ rang gi sems kyi gshis ci yang ma yin pa/ gdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa/ rtsal lha skur 'char ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas la 'dzin med du bzhag de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam rdo rje rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag de ltar na dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las phyi he ru ka yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ zhes brjod cing bsams la lha'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang la sems bzung*/ de nas bzlas pa byed na/ yum gyi thugs ka'i am̐ las sngags 'phreng byung zhal nas thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma nas zhugs te mgal me ltar 'khor ba'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ piṅga lorngahwake sha warta

ma ne/ tsa turbing+sha ti ni trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇi dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ne dhā ri ṇe/ adh+mā ta krū ra tsit+tā ya/ ar+dhen+du daṃṣ+ṭī ṇe/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardzadza ya gardzadza ya/ tardzadza ya tardzadza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rān/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ nā gā ṣ+ṭa kān/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sha trūn/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haḥphaṭ swāhā/ zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs ci nus dang*/ spro na/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzlas mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ yum yab la thim/ yab kyi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ ༄༅// chos skyong spyi'i gtor bsngo bzhugs so// hūm̐ dag pa bde stong lhun grub gzhal yas nas// mchog thun dngos grub stsol mdzad yi dam lha// kye rdor lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i// lha tshogs 'khor bcas 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// dur khrod brgyad sogs rang bzhin gnas mchog nas// bcom ldan 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum dang*// bde chen thugs gsung sku dang dam tshig gi /lha tshogs 'khor bcas 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// 'og min bde chen dag pa'i pho brang nas// rnam snang thugs las sprul pa'i mthu bo che// bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo rdo rje gur// dpal ldan mgon po 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// yongs 'du'i tshal dang gshin rje'i pho brang dang*// 'dzam gling de wa'i ko ḍa'i gnas mchog nas// 'dod khams gtso mo rnam 'phrul re ma ti// dpal ldan lha mo 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// bsil ba'i tshal dang ha ha rgod pa dang*// siṅga la dang ti si gangs ri dang*// dar lung gnas dang kha'u brag rdzong nas// zhing skyong dbang po 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// nub phyogs o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas// sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol// ci 'dod dngos grub char 'bebs nor gyi bdag

/gnas srung yab yum 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// grom stod sa skya'i bla brang nyi zla phug /dpal chen pho brang phu ri glang brag sogs// 'phags bod yang phur grub pa'i gnas mchog nas// dkar bdud phur srung 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// nub phyogs btsan yul zangs thang dmar po dang*// o ḍī ya na byang phyogs sham bha la// bod kyi bsam yas sprul pa'i gtsug lag nas// btsan rgod spun bdun 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*// rin chen mkha' 'gro pad+ma mkha' 'gro dang*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs gnas gsum gyi// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// rdo rje gdan sogs rang rang gnas mchog nas// 'dzam gling gzhi bdag spyi dang khyad par du// bod skyongs bstan ma yang sgos sa phyogs 'di'i// yul lha gzhi bdag 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes/ ༈ /gsol lo mchod do rgyal ba'i bstan srung tshogs// sgrub bo bsten no bla ma'i bka' srung che// 'bod do bskul lo rnal 'byor dgra lha mchog /rings pa'i tshul gyis 'dir byon mchod gtor bzhes// sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor mas mchod// dza gad sman phud rak+ta'i btung ba'i mchod// rnga chen rkang gling rol mo'i sgra yis mchod// dar nag 'phan chen sprin ltar gtib pas mchod// yid 'phrog spyan gzigs nam mkha' mnyam pas mchod// rab brjid snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ros mchod// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// bde stong dbyer med ye shes rol pas mchod// khyed rnams bdag gi phrin las zhu ba ni// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po khyed kyis srungs// dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyen po khyed kyis bstod// dpal ldan bla ma'i phrin las khyed kyis spel// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'dod don khyed kyis sgrubs// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod// khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob rnams// tshe ring gnad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// bsam pa'i don rnams chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod// dpal mchog ma hā kā la'i gzi brjid dang*// lha chen nag po gdong bzhi'i mthu rtsal dang*// las mgon pho nya rnams kyi phrin las kyis// gnas mchog 'dir yang bkra shis deng 'dir stsol/// /rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/

rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dges pa rdo rje 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug pa'i rang dang snang ba thams cad lha'i 'khor lor zhes pas/ zas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/ snying ga'i hūm̐ lha thams cad kyi ngo bor mchod par bsam pas longs spyad/ nub mor lhar snang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su sbyangs te nyal/ tho rangs lha'i rnal 'byor gyis langs te lam zab mo'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o// 'di ni kyai rdor gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs la lus dkyil sbyar/ dbang ni gzhung bshad sras don ma las lam dus kyi dbang blang tshul rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsung ba las/ 'dir rgyas pa de blang*/ de la dbang tshig rgyud nas bstan pa rnams la 'gyur 'dra min cung zad 'dug pa rnams ni 'don brjod bde ba'i phyir lus dkyil mdzes rgyan ltar bris/ dbang bzhi so so'i sngon gyi mchod pa sogs la 'dra min cung zad 'dug pa rnams ni/ dam pa gzhan gyi gsung rab dang yang cung zad bstun nas brjod bde don 'dus gtso bor byas mdor na kho bos rang bzor byas nas bris pa cung zad kyang med pas dpyod ldan rnams kyis de bzhin dgongs par mdzod cig

ces pa 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis mngon par mtho ba sprul sku rin po che kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis tshul 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba'i ngor shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phreng ba mdun du 'dus byas la/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa/ lag pa'i mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ bar tshar gcig brjod/ g.yon skor du gnas pa'i lte bar a/ lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ lag pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa/ ha k+ṣaḥ'i bar tshar gcig g.yas skor du gnas pa'i lte bar hūm̐ bsam/ de nas pad skor sngon du 'gro bas phreng ba blang la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bdud rtsi'i yi ge sum̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros par bsam/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du phreng ba bzung la/ thal mo phan tshun bsrub pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ rdo rje dang pad+ma snyoms par zhugs byang chub kyi sems sum̐ la khyab/ de ā li kā li la khyab/ de phreng ba dang gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ pa de pa de mahā dz+nyā na/ sarba bud+dha ma yaṃ bha wi te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes phreng ba gsar pa la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de phyin sngags 'di nyer gcig gam bdun nam gsum bzla bar bya'o// zhes rgyud dngos las byung ba'i phreng ba byin rlabs kyi le'u tshan no// // ༄༅// dpal gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs rgyun khyer nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

skyabs mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po dang*// gnyis med nag po cher btud nas// mgon po khro bo bcur bcas pa'i// sgrub thabs rgyun du khyer bde 'bri// de la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar ro// mi nus na/ bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// dpal ldan bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyas// chos dang dge 'dun thams cad la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// ci nus dang*/ gzhan don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir// nag po chen po bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang tshogs zhing lhan gcig pa ni/ gnas khang dur khrod rol pa'i nang*// mdun mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i khri// pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i steng*// brgyud pa kun 'dus drin chen rje// bla ma rdo rje nag po che// rgyan dang cha lugs yongs rdzogs sku// bdag la mkhyen brtse nus pa yis// rjes su skyong bzhin bzhugs par gyur// phyogs bcu'i bla ma rgyal ba sras// bstan srung nor lha spyan drangs bstim// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bdag nyid la// sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi// sdig ltung mthol bshags dge la dga'// don dam byang chub sems mchog gzung*// sangs rgyas thob phyir lam la 'jug /dge ba gzhan don byang chub bsngo// lhan skyes ye shes skye ba dang*// bstan srung 'khor bcas rang dbang 'dus// las bzhi'i phrin las lhun 'grub par// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o// gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs so// dus skad cig da lta nyid du bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsol btab la dgongs dgyes bzhin zhu// rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med 'dres// de'i ngang la ci gnas su mnyam par 'jog 'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// bder gnas btang snyoms la gnas gyur// oṃ shu n+ya ta sogs/

chos rnams rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings// sum skyes rdo rje brag rdzong steng*// e las chos 'byung khrag mtsho'i klong*// hūm̐ byung rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*// rwa gur srung 'khor yangs pa 'bar// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ de nang hūm̐ las gnam lcags kyi// 'khor lo rtsibs bcu sbubs stong brtan// oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bhūm̐ hūm̐/ dbus dang phyogs bcur pad nyi ror// hūm̐ res mtshan pa'i 'phro 'du las// bdag nyid gur mgon lha bcu gcig /sgyu ma ltar snang gtso bo'i phyag /gri gug thod pa gaṇ+ḍi bsnams// ye shes me klong zlum stabs bzhugs// sprul pa'i pho nya lnga sder 'phro// gzhan rnams brkyang bskum gri gug 'phyar// kun kyang mthing nag khros 'khrugs rngam// spyan gsum mche gtsigs mgo phreng dang*// rus rgyan sbrul stag dar gyis bklubs// me dpung klong bzhugs phyi rol du// phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu sprin sogs// dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs bskor ba'i// gnas gsum 'bru gsum hūm̐ 'od kyis// rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra byon// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rig lnga yang*/ tshur byon bdag la dbang bskur gsol// des kyang oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes dbang bskur/ dbang thob mi bskyod spyi bor brgyan// bskyed rim mo/ ༈ /zhar byung lce byin rlabs ni/ rang gi gre phug ram̐ yig dmar nag las// me 'bar tha mal ro 'dzin gzhob thul bsregs// hūm̐ yig las byung rdo rje dkar po'i ljags// rtse lnga'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar nyal thabs su// gnas pa'i mgo bo gre phug phyogs su bstan// de mthar dbyangs gsal dkar po g.yas su bskor// rwa rnams nang du sngags mgo gyen bsten pa'i// oṃ shrī ma hā ka la ya ma ma badz+ra dzi hwa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swā hā/ sngags las me 'bar me stag phram phram 'phros// ngag gi nyes skyon thams cad bsregs par gyur// gong gi sngags de nyer gcig sogs bzla/

rdo rje rtse lnga 'od du zhu ba las// ma hā ka la'i ljags kyi rnam par gyur// brag rdzong rgyas pa las blang ba'o// //rang gi snying gar rdo rje'i lter// hūm̐ yig bsrung bya sngags kyis bskor// lha rnams sngags kyi 'brug stong ldir// 'khor lo 'bar bas gdon bgegs bsregs// oṃ ma hā ka la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ci nus dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā ka lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ shā sa na ci nus bzlas mthar/ nag po chen po'i gsang gsum gyis// bdag dang sems can byin gyis rlobs// 'khor 'das dregs pa dbang 'dus nas// bstan 'gror phan pa bsgrub par shog /gnyis pa bzlog pa ni/ rtsibs bar nri tri sri rnams las// dgra bo gnod byed dmigs nas bkug /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥhūm̐ drag pos// khro bo phyir gzigs 'khor lo yang*// g.yon 'khor dgra bgegs dum bur gtubs// shā sa na spel tshig btags pa mang du bzla'o// spel tshig ni/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭan gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad kha kha khā hi khā hi mā ra mā ra sogs man chad dkyus ltar brjod pas chog go /oṃ bha ya nā sogs tshar gsum mthar/ bla ma'i sku dgra bstan pa'i dgra// rnal 'byor bdag la sdang sems dgra// kun gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams// byad ma rang gshed bzlog cing bsgyur// bsad bsgral rnam shes chos dbyings sbyor// 'khor gsum dmigs med ngang du mnyam par 'jog go hūm̐ hūm̐/ lha rnams nang gzigs 'khor g.yas 'khor// oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐// snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// snod bcud 'od zhu srung 'khor thim// srung 'khor dur khrod gdan bcas kyang*// 'od du zhu nas rang la thim// rang nyid rdo rje gur mgon gsal// rang gi dpral bar sogs/ dge ba 'di yis sogs/ bgegs dang log par sogs/ de las byung ba'i zhes sogs brjod do// smras pa/ kun mthong chung ngu'i snang srid dngos// ma 'gags 'char ba'i rten 'brel 'dis// brjod byed nyung ngus brjod bya'i lam// kun nas rdzogs pa'i ngo mtshar mtshon// 'dir 'bad bsod nams mig gsum mes// bgegs dgra'i yid srubs lus bcom nas// mi mthun las rgyal rgyal mtshan che// bstan pa'i mtha' dkyil bsgreng phyir bsngo// zhes rdo rje gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs rgyun khyer nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba 'di ni sde dge ban tshangs pa mkhas btsun dkon mchog bzang pos bskur ngor/
ban de tshul khrims rin chen gyis tshigs su bcad par bsdebs pa bi dza yan+tu/ dge'o// //

༄༅// gsung ngag lam gyi rim pa'i smon lam dngos grub nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'gro ba kun gyi 'dren mchog bla na med// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig 'dus pa// rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin can// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// mtshungs med brgyud pa'i bka' srol las 'ongs pa'i// smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang gis// skal ldan gdul bya'i re ba skong mdzad pa// blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gsang bdag rdo rje snying po'i sprul pa'i gar// ngur smrig bla gos 'chang ba'i brtul zhugs can// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag 'jam pa'i dbyangs// blo gter dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gdod nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas brnyes na yang*// bdag sogs dus mtha'i gdul bya'i don slad du// sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs pa// ngag dbang legs pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rnam 'phrul chos kyi rje// ma lus shes bya kun mkhyen paṇ+ḍi ta// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba'i sras// gzhan phan snang ba'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma'i rgyal tshab mchog /snang bzhi'i ye shes mthar son grub pa'i rje// sna tshogs rang sar grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa// dpa' bo rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// ma nyams tshul khrims mig 'bras bzhin du bsrungs// gzhan phan byang chub sems kyi nor gyis phyug /yun ring drin gyis skyong mdzad dge ba'i bshes// bstan 'dzin dbang grub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// chos brgyad tshe 'di'i zhen pa ring du spangs// zab mo dbu ma'i de nyid thugs su chud// rlabs chen gzhan phan spyod pas dus 'da' ba// 'jam dbyangs snyan grags zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs// rnam mang rgyud sde'i bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru phyin// smin grol gdams pa'i gter mdzod chos kyi rje// mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes 'jam pa'i dbyangs// ngur smrig gar gyis rol pa mkhyen brtse'i rje'i// gsang gsum ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul ba// chos kyi blo gros zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mdor na 'dren mchog ma ti'i mtshan can sogs// zab mo'i chos kyi bka' drin thob pa yi// bcu phrag gnyis kyi yongs 'dzin dam pa la// snying nas dad pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs// sna tshogs chab kyi rkyen las zla gzugs bzhin// gdul bya'i dbang gis rnam 'gyur tha dad kyang*// ngo bo sangs rgyas nyid du gcig pa yi// rje btsun bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// mkhas grub brgyud pa'i byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun// ma nyams gang thugs rgya mtshor gnas bcas pa'i// 'dren pa kun 'dus dpal mgon bla ma la// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// ma lus rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag che// rab 'byams yi dam dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso// dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal mgon bla ma la// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// rang don chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur// gzhan don gzugs sku'i snang ba 'gro la ston// sangs rgyas kun dngos dpal mgon bla ma la// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// mtha' yas shes bya'i de nyid thugs su chud// zab rgyas chos phung rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i gnas// lung rtogs yon tan dbang phyug bla ma la// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// nyon mongs dgra btul srid la rgyab kyis phyogs// gzhan phan sems 'byongs 'gro la bu ltar brtse// gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor bla ma la// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// bdud sde'i mun 'joms thub bstan pad+mo'i tshal// skyong mkhas phrin las rnam bzhi'i tsha zer can// dam can rgya mtsho'i ngo bo bla ma la// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// g.yo med dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na// phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i nor bu'i gru char gyis// srid zhi'i phongs pa sel mdzad bla ma la// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// mkha' khyab skyabs gnas rgya mtsho spro ba'i bdag

/sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// brtan g.yo kun khyab 'khor lo'i mgon po la// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// bdud dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal la sogs pa// btsal na rang las gzhan du mi rnyed pas// sems snang 'khrul pa'i 'jigs pa 'di mthong nas// rje btsun bla ma 'bod do thugs rjes gzigs// kun rtog nyon mongs rags shing dran shes med// rang skyon spong bar 'dod kyang gnyen po chung*// las ngan rang gi sdug bsngal ma bzod nas// rje btsun bla mar snying nas gsol ba 'debs// 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du// bla ma mchog las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas// rtag tu mi brjed dran pa'i gdung shugs kyis// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// sngon chad rang gis nyes pa spyad pa yis// rgyal ba'i phrin las snod du ma gyur pa'i// las ngan bdag gi blo sna bstung nas ni// sgo gsum chos la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// sngon gyi las dang rkyen las byung ba yi// mi dang mi min 'byung po'i gnod pa sogs// lus srog dge la bar du gcod pa yi// nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// lung rtogs yon tan rgyud la skye ba'i gegs// gnas grogs longs spyod ngan pa'i rkyen dbang sogs// phyi nang gsang ba'i bdud las ma lus pa// da lta nyid du zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// lus sems zug rngu'i rgyu ru gyur pa yi// gnas gos zas dang gnod byed gdon bgegs dang*// dam tshig nyams pa'i grib ma la sogs pas// nam yang gos pa med par byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul snang sdug bsngal kun gyis mi brdzi ba'i// 'jigs med dgongs pa'i btsan sa ma zin bar// dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa kun bsal nas// tshe srog ring du 'tsho bar byin gyis rlobs// rmongs pas bslus pas nyon mongs yan par shor// bag med dbang gis sgo gsum ma bsdams pas// thog med dus nas bdag gis bsags pa yi// las ngan sdig sgrib dag par byin gyis rlobs// gzhi med bdag tu bzung ba'i ma rig las// gnyis 'dzin chags sdang 'khrul pa'i blo byung ba// mi zad srid pa'i phung khrol kun gyi rgyu// nyon mongs rang mtshang rig par byin gyis rlobs// med snang smig rgyu'i chu bo'i rjes bsnyegs pa'i// kun rtog 'khrul pa'i ngal khur mi len par// 'grub med bsam pa'i mtha' rgya bskyungs nas ni// sems nyid las su rung bar byin gyis rlobs// 'dzem med mu cor smra ba'i ngang tshul 'di// rnam g.yengs nyon mongs bskyed pa'i rgyur shes nas// rang dang gzhan la phan nges ma gtogs pa'i// 'bras med smra brjod nyung bar byin gyis rlobs// bag med lang la shor ba'i sgo gsum po// rgyun du yang dag lam la bskul byed pa'i// dran shes bzang po'i sems kyi srung ma dang*// nam yang 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs// rkyen ngan bdud kyis khyer ram g.yeng bas bslus// chos min rtog pa skyes tshe de ma thag

/bla ma'i snang ba shar nas bdag gi blo// yang dag lam la gnas par byin gyis rlobs// 'dod yon sgyu ma'i nor la mi chags shing*// chog shes 'phags pa'i 'byor ba dang ldan pas// thub pa dgyes pa'i spyod pa la gnas te// tshe 'di'i bya ba spong bar byin gyis rlobs// rang bzhin mgu dka' byas la drin mi gzo// brten na bslu ba srin mo'i ngang tshul can// blo gtad med pa'i snyigs ma'i grogs spangs nas// bse ru'i rnam thar 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs// gzhan dbang 'du 'dzi'i 'ching ba las thar nas// chags dang sdang ba'i gtam yang mi thos shing*// rang bzhin nyams dga' rgyal bas bsngags pa yi// dben pa'i ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// phyi dang nang gi dge ba'i bshes kyis zin// mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i zas gos yo byad dang*// dge legs yon tan skyed pa'i gnas grogs sogs// mthun rkyen 'bad med rnyed par byin gyis rlobs// skyid 'dod tshe 'dir zhen pa'i blo ngan dang*// ltar snang gzhan don sgrub pa'i rnam g.yengs sogs// chos brgyad lam kha'i ro bzhin spangs nas ni// sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs// skyabs gsum ngo bo dpal mgon bla ma la// sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus kyis// khyed shes blo gtad nam yang mi 'gyur bas// snying nas skyabs su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs// rmongs pa'i blo la rab dga' skyed byed pa'i// srid pa'i phun tshogs gshed ma ltar mthong nas// sdug bsngal rang bzhin 'khor ba'i grong khyer la// zhen pa gting nas log par byin gyis rlobs// srid mtsho sgrol byed dal 'byor lus kyi gru// mi rtag g.yo ba'i rang bzhin de shes nas// skad cig tsam yang dal bar mi sdod par// sgrub la snying rus nus par byin gyis rlobs// stong pa'i dbyings su spros pa kun zhi yang*// snang ba rten 'byung bslu ba med pa'i phyir// kun rdzob dge sdig rgyu 'bras chos rnams la// blang dor tshul bzhin nus par byin gyis rlobs// tsha grang bkres skom skyo 'jigs la sogs pa// lus dang sems kyi sdug bsngal gang byung kun// las ngan sgrib sbyong rtogs pa'i bogs 'don du// rkyen ngan lam slong nus par byin gyis rlobs// phul byung snying stobs mchog gi go bgos nas// rgyal sras spyod pa'i khur chen 'khyer ba la// bye ba phrag brgya'i bdud sde dgrar langs kyang*// mi ldog brtson 'grus brtan par byin gyis rlobs// 'gro kun rang gi pha mar mthong nas ni// tshad med byams dang snying rjes rgyud bskul te// gzhan gyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog

/thob 'dod lhag bsam skye bar byin gyis rlobs// phrag dog 'gran sems nga rgyal kun gyi rgyu// rang nyid gces 'dzin 'gong po btul nas ni// bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sems mchog legs goms pas// rang don
