yid byed zad par byin gyis rlobs// lus srog longs spyod gang la'ang mi chags par// thams cad sgrol dang byams pa'i stobs bzhin du// nyams thag ma rgan 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams la// rtag tu phan bde sgrub par byin gyis rlobs// rnyed dka'i lus rten sbyin pa'i pha ma dang*// brtse gdung byams pas skyong ba'i gnyen bshes sogs// 'jigs rung srid pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad las// myur du bdag gis skyob par byin gyis rlobs// phangs pa'i srog la rgol ba'i dgra bo yang*// byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs su mthong nas ni// de yi rkyen gyis 'khrugs par mi 'gyur bar// dge tshogs lhag par 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// rmongs pas bslus pa byis pa'i skye bo yis// nyon mongs dbang gis log sgrub byed na yang*// smyo ba'i bu la byams pa'i ma bzhin du// slar yang brtse bas skyong bar byin gyis rlobs// bdag la brten nas gzhan gyi sems rgyud la// mi dge'i rtog pa nam yang mi skye zhing*// mthong thos tsam gyis 'brel ba tshun chod kyang*// blo kha chos la phyogs par byin gyis rlobs// gnod pa'i bsam sbyor rab tu goms pa yi// shin tu gdug cing gtum pa'i 'gro ba yang*// bdag nyid mthong thos dran pa'i skad cig la// byams pa'i sems dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs// mdor na gang du su dang 'grogs kyang rung*// chags sdang nyon mongs nam yang mi 'phel zhing*// 'phral dang yun gyi phan bde'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// rnam dkar dge ba rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// dgag sgrub gnang ba'i bcas mtshams ma nor bar// 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims la gnas shing*// rmi lam na yang nyams pa'i dri ma yis// nam yang gos pa med par byin gyis rlobs// phyi dang nang gi dben pa la brten nas// gcig tu zhi ba'i yid la mnyam bzhag pas// g.yeng ba'i rkyen gyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i// g.yo med ting 'dzin brtan par byin gyis rlobs// ji snyed shes bya'i gnas la ma rmongs pa'i// mtshungs pa med pa'i blo gros thob nas ni// zang zing med pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa yis// bstan la bya ba byed par byin gyis rlobs// mtha' bral lta ba'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin// ris med brtse ba'i gsal snang ma 'gags pa'i// chos kyi snying po don dam byang chub sems// tshul bzhin rgyud la 'byor par byin gyis rlobs// chags pa bdun spangs khyad chos bzhi ldan pa'i// rgya chen spyod pa'i nyams len phar phyin drug

/chos spyod gcig la'ang tshang bar sgrub nus pa'i// blo yi nus pa rnyed par byin gyis rlobs// spyod pa rmad byung bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma thul ba'i// shin tu gdul dka' snyigs ma'i 'gro ba la// chos kyi snang ba skyed par byin gyis rlobs// tshig don mtha' dag mi brjed gzungs kyi sgo// 'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs med spobs pa'i gter// ngo mtshar yon tan 'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin// ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// thabs shes zung 'jug smon pa'i mthu chen gyis// skad cig rer yang bskal pa'i tshogs 'dum zhing*// lhan cig rdzogs smin sbyang ba mthar phyin pa'i// kun bzang rnam thar skyong bar byin gyis rlobs// sna tshogs rgyu yi rten 'brel las byung ba'i// bzang ngan nyams kyi snang ba ma lus pa// zhen med rtsis gdab spangs pa'i lam khyer gyis// gang yang grogs su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// gsang gsum yon tan gter gyis rab gang ba'i// rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rgya mtsho lta bu la// zhum med spro ba'i yid kyis zhugs nas ni// 'phrin las ro gcig 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// mtshan nyid kun ldan rdo rje slob dpon mchog /rtse gcig dad pas tshul bzhin legs brten nas// ma nor brgyud pa'i bka' srol las 'ongs pa'i// rnam dag dbang gis smin par byin gyis rlobs// dbang las skyes pa'i nyams myong ye shes mchog /mi nyams spel ba'i thabs tshul bzhi ldan gyis// mnyam bzhag rjes spyod bza' srung mi 'bral ba'i// dam tshig srog bzhin srung bar byin gyis rlobs// phyi nang don gyi sngags kyi ngo bo shes// spro bsdu la sogs man ngag gnad kyis zin// ngag yid rlung gi lam la brten pa yi// bzlas brjod mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs// dngos grub 'gugs pa'i yo byad dam rdzas tshang*// sbyang rtogs sbar ba'i dmigs pa rang byan tshud// 'khor gsum yongs dag gtor ma'i rnal 'byor gyis// mkha' 'gro dam can mnyes par byin gyis rlobs// sdang mig tsam gyis bdud tshogs mthar byed pa'i// myur mgyogs 'phrin las dbang phyug srung ma'i tshogs// rnal 'byor bdag gi lus dang grib ma bzhin// mi 'bral rgyun du 'grogs par byin gyis rlobs// ting 'dzin sngags dang rdzas kyi nus pa yis// ye shes me lha mnyes pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// grub gnyis rin chen gter gyi sgo phyes nas// sgrub 'bras myur du 'byin par byin gyis rlobs//

shin tu gsang bar 'os pa yi// tshigs bcad drug po 'di ru 'jug /dngos grub rtsa ba bla ma lha ru mthong*// byin rlabs rtsa ba mos gus lam du longs// chos kun rtsa ba sems kyi de nyid rig /lam gyi srog rtsa zin par byin gyis rlobs// snod bcud 'khor 'das snang ba ma lus pa// nang gi rten 'brel nyid las byung ba'i tshul// rtogs nas sna tshogs phyi yi spros pa yi// sgro 'dogs nang nas chod par byin gyis rlobs// blo ngan rtog ges sgro skur ma yin par// nang gi de nyid rtogs pa'i nyams myong gis// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rgyud don 'chad nus pa'i// sbas don snying la 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// tshig la brten nas rnam mang chos tshul gyi// pha mtha' tshol ba'i ngal ba mi dgos par// bde blag nyid du kun mkhyen sgrub pa yi// rten 'brel nang du 'grigs par byin gyis rlobs// sna tshogs 'gro ba'i khams dbang mos pa bzhin// bgrang yas chos tshul rgya mtsho spro mkhas shing*// kun kyang rgyal ba'i lam du sdud bzod pa'i// bde gshegs chos mdzod lon par byin gyis rlobs// rten 'brel lnga ldan gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos// tshad ma bzhi yis gtan la legs phab nas// snyan brgyud bzhi yi rten 'brel rang rgyud la// tshul bzhin myur du 'grigs par byin gyis rlobs// bogs 'byin gdams pa'i bdud rtsi rkyen dang 'tshams// gegs sel srung ba'i man ngag dus dang 'byor// 'dus pa gsum gyi lam 'phrang tshul bzhin brgal// drod rtags yon tan skye bar byin gyis rlobs// rlung sems yi ge'i khrid tshul rgyud la 'byor// las 'phro mos gus brtson pas byang sems bskul// gsal stong zung 'jug nyams kyi snang ba 'bar// lam mchog myur du bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// sum cu rtsa bdun byang chub phyogs mthun chos// lus dang sems kyi steng du bgrod pa'i tshul// rtogs nas rgyu 'bras theg pa'i brjod bya'i gnad// mi 'gal gcig tu mthong bar byin gyis rlobs// rgyu lam dbang gi ye shes chu bo'i rgyun// ma nub thun bzhi'i 'jug ngogs la brten nas// mthar thug rnam mkhyen ye shes rgya mtsho ru// gegs med myur du snyogs par byin gyis rlobs// rgyud gsum lhan skyes dbye ba ma lus pa// lhun grub sems kyi chos nyid 'di nyid las// nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i tshul shes nas// ma rig 'khrul pa sangs par byin gyis rlobs// cir yang snang ba rang sems gsal ba'i gdangs// gang du'ang ma grub sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can// rten 'byung snang ba spros pas ma bslad par// brjod bral rang zhal mjal bar byin gyis rlobs// kun nyon rgyu 'bras ma spangs lam du khyer// sku dang ye shes ma bsgrubs lhun gyis grub// re dogs dgag sgrub spros pa dbyings su zhi// 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// skyon nyid yon tan mchog gi rgyur mthong zhing*// bar chad bdud las dngos grub len nus pa'i// cir snang dge ba'i bshes su 'char ba yi// 'jigs med gdeng drod rnyed par byin gyis rlobs// rnam mang rtog pa'i rba rlabs cher g.yo bas// bde chen sems kyi gnas cha mi bsgribs shing*// kun rtog nyon mongs 'khrugs pas ye shes kyi// gsal snang mchog tu 'dren par byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul ngor snang ba'i srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'di// 'khrul par shes na bde chen ye shes te// snang srid bde bar rol pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// sdug bsngal dbyings su sangs par byin gyis rlobs// bying rgod nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa dang*// skyon med zung 'jug nyams kyi ting 'dzin gnyis// bzang ngan med par lam du bsrel nus pa'i// gdams pa nyams su lon par byin gyis rlobs// spangs thob dbyer med rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu// yang dag shes nas gnyis 'dzin re dogs kyi// rtog pa'i drwa ba nam yang mi spel bar// 'bras bu'i mchog 'dzin zhig par byin gyis rlobs// gzhi snang skye gnas 'chi ba bar do bzhi// rim dang cig char sbyong ba'i lam khyer gyis// myur du sku bzhi'i ngo bor dag byed pa'i// bskyed rim lam bzang goms par byin gyis rlobs// gdos bcas gzugs kyi snang ba lha ru mthong*// grags pa sgra yi rang gdangs sngags su shes// dran rtog yid kyi 'gyu ba chos skur dag

/rdo rje gsum mchog 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// rang sems lha brgya'i ngo bo rdo rje sems// kun khyab rigs kyi bdag por mthong ba'i mod// yi dam rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i 'dzum zhal mchog /dus gcig nyid la mthong bar byin gyis rlobs// zab mo'i lam gyis lus la gnad du bsnun// byin rlabs stobs kyis rtogs pa sems la shar// snang sems ro gcig ye shes mngon du gyur// rdzogs rim pha mthar son par byin gyis rlobs// da lta'i rang gi snang ba 'di nyid las// lam dang 'bras bu logs nas mi tshol bar// rgyu 'bras rgyas gdab man ngag la brten nas// spros pa'i drwa ba mchod par byin gyis rlobs// mtshan rtog 'chal ba'i dri mas ma gos pa'i// bde chen ye shes sdom pa'i ngo bo ru// smin grol lam gyi zab gnad kun dril nas// dus gcig nyams su lon par byin gyis rlobs// 'khor 'das bsre ba'i gsang gnad la brten nas// rjes spyod lam gyi yan lag gcig la yang*// gzhi lam 'bras gsum tshang ba'i lam khyer gyis// grub gnyis mgron du khugs par byin gyis rlobs// tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba ma lus pa// zag med bde ba'i nye rgyur mthong nas ni// gang shar bde stong rol pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// 'dod yon rgyan du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// gtsang sme gnyis rtog 'joms pa'i dam rdzas la// mnyam nyid brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rol pa yis// mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i thabs kyi dga' ston gyis// bde stong ye shes 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// rmi lam nying 'khrul snang ba rang ngo zin// sprul bsgyur brtan pa thob pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// rgyal ba kun las dam chos nyan pa dang*// nyams rtogs bogs 'don byed par byin gyis rlobs// nyin snang 'khrul pa sgyu ma'i rol par shes// mtshan snang ma rig 'od gsal dbyings su dengs// nyin mtshan bar med sgrib bral ye shes kyi// snang ba 'gags pa med par byin gyis rlobs// mdor na 'khrul snang blo yi ri mo kun// spros bral 'od gsal don dam chos kyi sku// mngon sum mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes su// rtsol med ngang gis 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// mthar 'dzin rtog pa'i rdul gyis ma bslad cing*// gzung 'dzin snang ba'i sprin gyis ma bsgribs par// lhan skyes bde chen rig stong gnyug ma'i gshis// rang byung ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// srog rtsol rlung gi rgyu ba dbang du 'dus// mnyen lcug bzhi yi yon tan lus la shar// skye mched drug tu dwangs ma'i nus pa 'phel// ting 'dzin mthu chen rnyed par byin gyis rlobs// tha dad gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa bzhin// ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul bkod pa'i las la dbang*// zhi sogs dngos grub bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyis// 'gro ba'i phan bde spel bar byin gyis rlobs// phyi nang rten 'brel mthun pa'i spyod mchog gis// so gnyis yul gyi mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus// sum phrag bcu gnyis rtags kyi yon tan rnams// ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// 'gros bzhi dbyings su bsdu ba'i rgyal thabs kyis// gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i g.yul ngo rab bcom nas// che ba gsum ldan chos sku'i rgyal srid la// dbang bskur tshe 'dir thob par byin gyis rlobs// rten 'brel mthar thug sku lnga'i pad tshal du// dbang phyug brgyad kyi bung ba'i tshogs 'du zhing*// lhun grub 'phrin las sbrang rtsi'i ro bcud kyis// skal ldan gdul bya tshim par byin gyis rlobs// thog mar lta sgom spyod la rim gyis zhugs// bar du gsum po gnad thog gcig tu dril// tha mar bsam brjod bral ba'i ye shes su// thams cad ro mnyam rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// bgrang yas mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po'i don// rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro bye ba'i thugs kyi bcud// lam dus thun bzhi'i nyams len la brten nas// nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// tha mal snang zhen skyabs kyi ngo bor dag

/bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byang chub lam du bsgyur// sdig ltung ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas// rang rgyud shin tu dag par byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul snang las nyon rnam dag tshogs su bsgyur// bdud rigs bar chad srung ba'i 'khor lor shar// tha mal snod bcud rten dang brten pa yi// lhag pa'i lha ru 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// lus la sku bzhi lhun gyis grub par rtogs// sems las logs na ye shes med par rig /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med par mthong*// zung 'jug ting 'dzin skye bar byin gyis rlobs// phung po sangs rgyas nyon mongs ye shes dang*// sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo ru// shes nas goms pas rgyu 'bras lhun grub kyi// sangs rgyas rang las rnyed par byin gyis rlobs// rtsa yig rlung sems rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams// smin grol thabs kyi mchod pas mnyes byas nas// rang byung gnyis med ye shes don gyi lha'i// rang zhal myur du mjal bar byin gyis rlobs// dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ye shes kyis// rjes thob snang ba'i chos la rgyas 'debs shing*// chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas// mtshan rtog 'khrul 'khor 'jig par byin gyis rlobs// snang srid dag pa lha yi 'khor lor rdzogs// rtsa thig rlung gi dwangs ma chos skur smin// 'khor 'das ye shes gcig gi ngo bor zlum// mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs// sku drin mtshungs med yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter// dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// snying nas yid ches bcos ma ma yin pa'i// mos gus rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// sgo gsum longs spyod dge tshogs rgyur byas pa'i// phyi nang gsang ba de nyid bcas pa yi// kun bzang rnam 'phrul lta bu'i mchod sprin gyis// dpal ldan bla ma mchod par byin gyis rlobs// skyabs gnas kun 'dus phyi yi bla ma mchog

/nyin mo spyi bor mtshan mo snying dbus su// rtag tu bsgoms shing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// 'bral med rjes su 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs// shin tu gsang ba nang gi rten 'brel las// sku bzhi'i bla ma 'byung ba'i tshul shes nas// nang gi bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs mkhas kyis// byin rlabs sems la 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// rang bzhin 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs mchog /don gyi bla ma'i rang zhal mjal ba'i mod// gnyis snang mtshan ma'i 'khrul 'khor zhig nas ni// 'khor ba'i rdzun ris dag par byin gyis rlobs// skyabs gnas thams cad bla ma'i ngo bor mthong*// dge sbyor thams cad bla ma'i lam du shar// 'khor 'das thams cad bla ma'i rol par shes// snang srid bla mar 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dpal mgon bla ma las// byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i dngos grub legs thob nas// da lta'i 'dug sa stan thog 'di nyid du// dgongs pa dbyer med 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// rgyu rigs thabs kyi rim pas legs sbyangs nas// 'bad pas 'bras bu sgrub la mi ltos par// bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i skad cig la// rtogs grol dus mnyam 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// dbang bzhi'i chu bo dus gcig nyid la thob// lam bzhi'i ngo bo rig thog gcig tu rdzogs// sku bzhi gnyis med rang rig bde ba che'i// ye shes gcig tu mthong bar byin gyis rlobs// dri med sems kyi chos nyid byang chub sems// blo dang tshig gis ma bcos gdod ma'i gshis// stong gsal phyogs ris bral ba'i bla ma las// nam yang g.yo ba med par byin gyis rlobs// sems can sangs rgyas dgongs pa gcig tu mthong*// lam dang 'bras bu'i tha snyad dbyings su nub// gnyis chos thams cad gnyis med klong du dag /kun kyang tshul gcig rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// lhun grub gnas 'gyur 'gal med don rtogs nas// gzhi 'bras dbyer med skyon yon ro mnyam pa'i// zung 'jug bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa// lus rten 'di la thob par byin gyis rlobs// bde chen dbyings las g.yo ba med bzhin du// sna tshogs gzugs sku'i rol pa bsam yas kyis// mkha' mnyam 'khor ba ma stong de srid du// bla ma'i 'phrin las skyong bar byin gyis rlobs// mdor na dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du// skyid sdug legs nyes snang ba ci shar yang*// dpal mgon bla ma dran pa'i mos gus dang*// nam yang 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs// g.yo med don yod rnam bzhi'i spyod pa yis// 'khor lo'i mgon po legs par mnyes byas nas// myur du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs// sku bzhi'i sa bon smin grol thabs kyis sbyangs// lta ba'i nyams myong grub mtha'i ngo bor shar// nye rgyu la brten 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung thob// rdo rje 'chang dbang 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub pa na// lus dang sems la sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing*// zab lam rtogs pa'i gdeng drod dang ldan pas// mi 'jigs rab dga' rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// de tshe drin chen bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pas// yid 'phrog mchod pa'i sprin gyis mdun bsus te// dag pa'i zhing du khrid par byin gyis rlobs// der ni tshe la dbang ba'i rig pa 'dzin// mkha' la spyod pa'i 'od lus grub nas ni// rten des sa lam lhag ma kun bgrod de// kha sbyor bdun ldan 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// yon tan rgya mtsho bdag gis thob nas ni// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams pa'i 'gro khams la// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter gyi sgo phyes nas// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem par byin gyis rlobs// ma 'ongs slad ma'i skye ba thams cad du// rigs bzang blo gsal nyon mongs chung ba dang*// mchog la gus shing dman la shin tu byams// rtag tu tshe rabs dran par byin gyis rlobs// der yang bla ma dam pa mnyes byed cing*// bstan la rab byung tshul khrims rnam par dag

/lung dang rtogs pa'i chos kyi mdzod bzung nas// 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs byed par byin gyis rlobs// deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob bar// bla ma mchog dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing*// sras bcas rgyal ba'i 'phrin las skyong ba la// 'gal rkyen bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs// g.yo med snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i don// bslu med rten 'brel zab mo'i bden pa dang*// mtshungs med drin chen bla ma'i thugs rje yis// gegs med myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// slar smras pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod// shes rab bdag med mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi chab// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog gi bzhed pa'i gzhung*// 'phags bod grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog rnams kyi/ snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i zab pa'i chos// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyams len kun tshang ba// rgyud dang grub pa'i man ngag las 'ongs pa'i// dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje'i lam gyi srol// rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i// dri med ring lugs zab mo'i chos 'di la// lam gyi khrid tshul mang du bzhugs pa las// zab 'bring tha gsum lam gyi rim pa yi// nyams len snying po phal cher bsdus nas ni// tshul bzhin rang gi rgyud la 'byor ba'i phyir// rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rje bskul ba'i ngag /dngos grub nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rta 'di// shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis// mi med lung stong nyul ba'i dus kyi tshe// blun po rang gi sdug bsngal ma bzod nas// rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs phyir bris// skyes dang sbyangs pa'i blo gros shin tu dman// zab mo'i lam la 'dris goms ma bgyis shing*// las ngan khur gyis non pa'i byis pa bdag /zab don 'chad la dbang ba ma yin pas// bdag blo 'khrul pa'i dri mas sbags pa dang*// sbas don gsal bar bshad pa la sogs pa// gal te 'di la nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na// rje btsun mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol// zab mo'i lam 'di'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa'i// brgyud 'dzin dam pa gong mas mdzad pa yi// khrid gzhung rnams su gsal bar ma gsungs pa// 'ga' zhig 'di na yod mod rang bzo min// dang po'i las can rim gyis bkri tshul dang*// gdams pa yongs rdzogs thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas// stan thog gcig tu nyams su len tshul gyi// rnam dbye legs par khong du chud pa dang*// dbang bzhi'i lam gyis so sor bkri ba dang*// lam bzhi'i rnal 'byor rim bzhin bsgom pa dang*// gcig tu dril nas nyams su len pa sogs// lam gyi 'jug ldog tshul la ma rmongs shing*// 'khor 'das thun mong chos bdun so so dang*// gcig tu bsres nas nyams su len tshul la// rmongs pa med pa'i blo gros thob pa na// zab mo'i don la yid ches skye bar 'gyur// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku// 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul rje btsun sa skya pa// brtse chen yab sras brgyud par bcas pa la// sgo gsum gus pas slar yang phyag bgyi'o// legs gsung mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po'i bcud// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal 'ongs bdud rtsi'i rgyun// tshig tsam thos na'ang 'chi med mchog sbyin pa'i// de yi gsung rab la yang gus phyag 'tshal// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po thams cad kyi// chos tshul rgya mtsho'i snying po yongs bsdus nas// phyi rabs gdul bya'i skal par bzhag pa yi// gong ma'i gsung rab ston pa'i rgyal tshab yin// mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod bdud rtsi'i chu gter las// sngon byon grub pa'i ded dpon gyis blangs pa'i// 'dod 'byung gzhung bzang yid bzhin nor bu 'di// sa skya'i rjes 'jug yongs kyi spyi nor lags// srid dang zhi ba'i phongs pa kun sel ba'i// gsang chen gdams pa'i gter 'di rnyed nas ni// spyod dang gzhan la sbyin par mi byed par// da dung slong mor rgyu na smyo'am ci// rtog ge'i blo yis 'ol tshod ma yin par// 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun// tshad ma bzhi yis gtan la 'bebs nus pa'i// gzhung bzang 'di 'dra 'jig rten dag na dkon// sde snod gsum gyi zab don 'di na bzhugs// rgyud sde bzhi yi nyams len 'di la tshang*// man ngag kun gyi gter kha 'di na yod// gzhung bzang 'di ni rgyal ba'i chos mdzod yin// yon tan bskyed pa'i thabs kyi rnam grangs mang*// spros pa gcod pa'i shes rab ral gri rno// zung 'jug nyams su len pa'i rim pa zab// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang 'di 'dra med// rtag ltas ma gos bden med sgyu mar ston// chad lta ma yin rten 'brel lam du byed// rtog ges ma bslad mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud 'di// 'dor bar byed na sems yod ji ltar yin// lta ba yangs pas gang la'ang zhen pa gcod// spyod pa zhib pas blang dor tshul bzhin ston// thabs la mkhas pas lta spyod zung du 'jug

/lam bzang 'di shes sangs rgyas mi ring nye// thun tshags ma yin mdo rgyud kun gyi bcud// rang bzos ma bslad 'khrul med brgyud pa'i srol// byin rlabs ma nyams snyan brgyud bzhi ldan pa'i// lam 'di mkhas grub bye ba'i gshegs shul yin// smin byed dbang gi cho ga ma 'khrugs shing*// grol byed lam gyi rim pa zab cing rgyas// bogs 'byin lam gyi yan lag kun tshang ba'i// chos 'di rig 'dzin yongs kyi thugs dam yin// rang gi nyams len phyogs su ma lhung zhing*// gzhan gyi chos la sgro skur mi dgos par// dag snang ngang nas dge sbyor 'phel ba zhig /gzhung 'dir thos bsam byas pa'i lag rjes yin// bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang*// gzhung lugs thams cad gdams pa 'char ba zhig /nyams myong tshad mas gtan la 'bebs 'dod na// zab mo'i don 'di sgom pas nyams su longs// yid 'ongs sa 'dzin mthon po'i rtse mo nas// dma' ba'i ljongs su ltad mo lta ba bzhin// grub mtha' kun gyi gnad gsang dus gcig tu// mthong ba 'di yang lam 'di'i che ba lags// gang zhig mthong na srid pa'i mun 'joms pa// thub pa'i chos tshul rten 'byung zab mo'i don// bstan pa 'di las phyi rol ma gyur pa'i// grub mtha' 'dzin pa kun la grags na yang*// shin tu gsang ba nang gi rten 'brel gyi// zab mo'i don ni man ngag 'di nyid las// bka' srol gzhan gyis gsal bar ma mdzad pas// lugs 'di gzhan las khyad par 'phags zhes gsungs// rgyu las 'bras bu logs nas mi tshol zhing*// gzhi 'bras dbyer med rtogs pa'i nye lam gyis// rang bzhin lhun grub sku bzhi ngo sprod pa'i// zab mo'i lam 'di mtshan don mthun pa lags// tha snyad tshig gi lam la ma brten par// zab mo nang gi rten 'brel bsgom pa'i mthus// ji snyed shes bya'i gnas la ma rmongs pa'i// shes rab klong rdol lam 'di'i khyad chos yin// grangs med bskal pa'i yun la mi ltos par// tshe gcig nyid la gdos bcas sgyu ma'i lus// 'ja' lus dwangs ma'i sku ru sgyur byed pa'i// gdams ngag 'di ni gser 'gyur rtsi dang 'dra// gdul bya'i blo dang skal pa'i rim pa bzhin// thabs mkhas lam gyi bkri tshul mang ba'i phyir// srid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs kun ster ba'i// gzhung bzang 'di ni yid bzhin nor bu bzhin// gzhan ngor skyon dang bar chad ltar snang yang*// rang snang bde ba chen po'i ye shes su// mthong nas 'khrul snang gang gis mi rdzi ba'i// rkyen ngan lam slong gdams pa 'di 'dra med// skyid na gong non 'dod yon lam du byed// sdug na skyo grogs gang snang grogs su 'char// nyams len gegs sel gdams ngag bogs 'don pa'i// gzhung bzang 'di ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin// 'di don shes na kun la dag snang skye// tshul bzhin bsgoms na snang ba lha ru 'char// mngon sum rtogs na sangs rgyas dngos yin pas// lam bzang 'di 'dra mjal rnams skal pa bzang*// las 'phro bzang zhing mos gus mchog ldan pa// sna tshogs lam gyi spros pa ma brten kyang*// skad cig nyid la sangs rgyas byed pa yi// dbang po rab kyi chos kyang 'di nas gsungs// dbang las skyes pa'i ye shes ma nyams par// man ngag tshul bzhi'i srung ba'i thabs mkhas kyis// mi ring myur du sangs rgyas byed pa yi// dbang po 'bring gi nyams len 'di na bzhugs// rnam lnga'i rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs nas ni// 'bad rtsol drag pos rgyun du goms byas pas// ye shes skyes nas grol bar 'gyur ba yi// dbang po tha ma'i chos kyang 'di nas gsungs// gzhan yang blo dang skal pa'i rim pa bzhin// thabs shes phyogs su zhen pas dbye ba yi// dbang po rab 'bring drug gi bkri tshul sogs// lam gyi khrid tshul nyi shu rtsa brgyad bzhugs// de slad gang dag gzhung 'dir dad na yang*// lam 'di ha cang spros pa rgya che bas// 'di 'dra nyams su len par mi nus zhes// sngangs skrag skye ba thugs rgyus chung ba'i rtags// brgyud pa mchog 'di'i bka' srol las 'ongs pa'i// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi man ngag sogs// rang gi nyams len gang la brtson kyang rung*// lam gyi spyi gzhung 'di 'dras zin pa dgos// rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa 'di yin zhing*// gsang 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud 'di lags mod// 'on kyang snyigs ma'i dus kyi shugs brtas pas// bstan pa'i snang byed 'di ni nub la nye// theg gsum lam gyi rtogs rigs ma lus pa// mchog gsang snying po'i thabs mkhas la brten nas// rig thog gcig la nyams su len nus pa'i// lam 'di kun mkhyen sgrub pa'i myur lam yin// 'di 'dra mngon sum rtogs na smos ci dgos// go yul tsam du nyams su myong bas kyang*// srid pa'i snang shes hrul por bgyid nus na// 'di la mi spro blo ldan su zhig yod// 'gal 'du sdeb pa rtog ge'i blo gros kyis// zab mo'i don 'di rtogs par mi nus pas// bla ma'i bka' bzhin byin rlabs brgyud pa'i srol// mos gus kho nas nyams su len par rigs// mkhas grub bla ma'i nyin byed dkyil 'khor rgyas// dri med gsung gi 'od snang 'bum g.yo ba// blo gros pad+mo'i gnyen du 'thung shes na// zab don rtogs pa'i pad tshal bzhad par nges// rten 'brel 'di 'dra phyi nas rnyed dka' bas// blo gros lus sgrim mang thos ral pas brjid// skal bzang sdom brtson mi yi seng ge dag

/snyan brgyud gangs ri 'dzin pa'i dus la babs// dri med ring lugs chos kyi snang ba 'di// chos kyi dbang phyug bla ma'i 'dun sa ru// nyi ma'i 'od bzhin khyab par brdal na yang*// skal ngan 'ug pa'i tshogs kyis rnam par spangs// nges don gsung ngag yan lag brgyad pa'i chus// chos 'dod skom pas gdung ba'i rjes bsnyegs kyang*// smig rgyu'i chu bo tshol ba'i ngal ba yis// blo gsal 'ga' zhig dub par ma gyur tam// bla ma'i thugs zin gsung ngag gdams pa'i bcud// legs par myangs nas dben pa'i ri khrod du// rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa// skal bzang de las skyid pa su zhig yod// dug lnga 'khrugs kyang ye shes skye ba'i rgyu// bdud dpung lhag kyang dngos grub stsol ba'i grogs// 'khrul snang shar ba lha dang ye shes su// mthong ba de yang de la ring mi 'gyur// srid rtsa drung 'byin dge slong de yin te// 'brel tshad don ldan rgyal ba'i sras po'ang de// bde chen bdud rtsi'i chang la rtag rol pa'i// rig pa 'dzin pa'i ded dpon dngos kyang de// mdor na lnga bdo snyigs ma'i dus su yang*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lag rtser gtod nus pa'i// bskal mang rnyed dka'i zab chos rin po che'i// yon tan mtha' dag su zhig brjod par nus// bstan pa'i bdag po bla chen phal mo ches// stobs 'byor mnga' thang sgrub pa'i rnam g.yeng gis// brgyud pa mchog 'di'i bka' srol las 'ongs pa'i// zab chos tshol la thugs las chung bar mdzad// bstan la gsar du zhugs pa'i blo gsal rnams// lto chos lag len sgrub pa'i ltad mo la// de dag gis kyang blo mig g.yengs nas ni// zab mo'i chos 'di sa 'og gter bzhin lus// sgrub brtson dam pa'i skyes bu phal cher yang*// bzlas grangs tsam la thugs rtse gtod pa las// zab chos 'di 'dra rang la yod pa yang*// gsan pa med na nyams su ji ltar bzhes// brgyud ldan bla ma tshul bzhin ma bsten pa'i// skyes sbyangs blo gros gsal ba'i mkhas pas kyang*// gzhung 'di bshad yam tsam du gzigs nas ni// snying po'i nyams len gzhan du tshol bar dgongs// kye ma 'jam mgon sa skya'i bstan pa ni// ltag chu zad pa'i rdzing bu'i ngang tshul bzhin// da ni shin tu nyams par mthong na yang*// snyigs ma'i rang mdangs bcos su ci zhig yod// bzlas grangs song bas mgrin pa skya ba dang*// za chog shes pas lto ba skya ba dang*// phyogs 'dzin byed pas kha skya tsam min par// snying nas sa skya'i bstan pa 'dzin bzhed na// yid ches rgyal ba'i bka' dang khyad med pa'i// 'khrul zad gong ma'i gsung rab 'di dag la// thos bsam bsgom pa'i sgo nas 'jug nus na// dal 'byor rin chen rnyed pa don bcas yin// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa grub pa'i dbang phyug gis// bkral ba'i bod kyi grub mtha' su la yang*// rab gus dad pas yid ches bskyed pa las// ma gus phyogs 'dzin bdag gi rgyud la med// 'on kyang pha rgod bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// dpal ldan sa skya'i chos 'di'i rigs su skyes// me tog phog pa'i lha skal 'di nyid yin// brgyud pa bzang po'i pha chos 'di nyid yin// de slad brtson pas nyams su ma lon kyang*// zab pa'i yang rtse chos tshul 'di nyid la// yid ches bskyed nas mi med lung stong du// sprang po bdag ni 'chi ba bsgug snying 'dod// yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs ma yal ba'i// chos 'di bsgom pas nyams su ma lon kyang*// phas rgol 'bum gyis 'phrog par mi nus pa'i// yid ches dad pa snying gi dkyil na yod// chos 'di'i glegs bam sngas su bzhag nas ni// dpal mgon bla ma yid la dran bzhin du// mi rtag lnga pa'i lam du song na yang*// 'gyod pa med do chos mthun grogs po dag

/bla ma'i drin gyis las ngan bdag 'dra yang*// chos 'di'i rigs su skyes par khas 'che na// skal bzang blo gsal dam pa gzhan dag gis// brtson par mdzad na smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal// bla ma mjal yang tshul bzhin ma bsten la// gdams ngag thos kyang nyams su ma lon zhing*// dben pa bsten kyang brtson 'grus ma nus pa'i// sdig ldan bdag gi snying la ci zhig zhugs// las ngan mtsho chen rdol ba'i rmongs pa bdag /lha dang bcas pa'i snying rje'i yul yin mod// chos 'di'i bdud rtsi rna ba'i bu ga ru// son pa 'di tsam phyi ma'i lam rgyags yin// las nyon khur lci gshis ngan bdag 'dra yang*// thugs brtse'i thugs kyis rjes su bzung ba yi// dpal mgon bla ma'i bka' drin dran pa'i tshe// mchi ma'i rgyun gyis 'dren byed brlan par byas// ma lus mkha' khyab 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon// nyams thag bdag gi byang chub bar gyi skyabs// 'jam mgon bla ma'i bka' lung ji bzhin du// bsngags pa'i tshig 'di gus pa'i yid kyis sbyar// chos tshul 'di yi yon tan mtha' klas pa// chos med bdag gi spyod yul ma yin yang*// chos rje bla ma'i gsung gis yun ring du// bskyangs pa'i go yul phyogs tsam bshad pa lags// 'di bgyis pa las byung ba'i dge ba kun// 'di nyid go yul tsam du mi 'jog par// 'di bzhin rang gis nyams su blangs pa'i mthus// 'di don rgyud la 'byor pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// tshe rabs kun tu rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// 'jam mgon bla ma brgyud par bcas pa yi// 'bangs su gyur nas mkha' mtha'i rjes 'gro ba'i// lhun grub 'phrin las bdag gis skyong bar shog/ //

dge'o// dge'o// // ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ tshe rabs kun tu de bzhin gshegs pa la// bkur sti rnyed dang sgrub pa'i mchod pa dang*// rim gro bya ba'i rnam pa dpag med pa'i// smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 1 /rgyal ba'i dam chos kun gyi tshig don rnams// gzung zhing nyams pa med par bsrung ba dang*// chos tshul zab mo yang dag gzung ba yi// smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 2 /dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs pa nas brtsams te// myang 'das bar gyi mdzad pa kun ston pa// drung du 'gro zhing chos kun sdud byed pa'i// smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 3 /gzhan don sgrub byed bsdu dngos rnam bzhi dang*// sangs rgyas chos rnams rdzogs byed phyin drug sogs// rgyal sras spyod pa thams cad legs spyad pa'i// smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 4 /sems can kun la dam pa'i chos bstan pas// dad sogs dbang pos smin nas 'phags pa'i lam// dngos su skye zhing sgrib pa spong rung ba'i// smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 5 /ba spu'i khung bur zhing gi rdul snyed kyi// 'jig rten khams kun sprul nas de dag tu// rgyal dang rgyal sras spyod pa kun ston pa'i// smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 6 /snod bcud zhing gi skyon rnams rab spangs nas// gser gyi gzhi dang dge bcu spyod pa sogs// sangs rgyas zhing gi yon tan kun ldan pa'i// smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 7 /theg pa mchog la 'jug phyir byang sems dang*// gcig tu gzhan la phan pa'i bsam sbyor kun// rnam pa kun tu gcig par bya ba yi// smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 8 /thog mar sems mchog bskyed pa nas bzung ste// bar du yang dag lam gyi sbyor ba kun// tha mar 'bras bu mchog gi don yod pa'i// smon lam chen mo myur du 'grub par shog /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal las legs byung ba'i// don gnyis mthar phyin bla med rdzogs byang chub// 'gro ba'i don du mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i// smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog

10 / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde las sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi smon lam 'bum phrag grangs med bcu btab pa thams cad smon lam chen po bcur 'dus par gsungs pa'i don byang sa dang*/ mdo sde rgyan dang*/ 'jug 'grel gyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du gzhan phan gyi bsam pa cung zad dang ldan pa bsod nams seng ges cho 'phrul chen po'i rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i nyi ma la tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa 'di kun gyis 'dzin pa dang kha 'don du mdzad par zhu/// /dge'o// // ༄༅// bsngo smon bzhugs so// dmigs yul ngan song sdug bsngal mi myong zhing*// bka' ba spyod pa med par yang*// lha bas lhag pa'i lus kyis ni// de dag sangs rgyas myur grub shog ༈ 'di nas nying mtshams sbyar ma thag /dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can// pad+ma'i snying po ze'u 'bru las// rdzus te skye ba len par shog ༈ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa// srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba'i// bde ba can du skye bar shog ༈ bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa bzhugs// smon lam dag pa'i zhing sa yi// de yi drung du skye bar shog ༈ zung 'jug chos sku ma thob de srid du// dga' ldan chos kyi rgyal ba'i khang bzang la// mi pham chos kyi bla ma'i zhabs drung du// theg chen chos kyi dga' ston rgyas par shog ༈ bdag la dmigs rten grangs med pa// byung ba'i tshe 'das thams cad kyi// sdig pa kun bshags kun byang nas// kun kyang bde ba can bsgrod shog ༈ byang chub sems mchog rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa yang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog ༈ /des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtson te// byang chub sems ni nam yang brjed ma gyur// sdig pa gang rnams sgrib par gyur pa dag /de dag ma lus yongs su byang bar shog ༈ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig

/ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stong pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar zhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub gyur cig ༈ 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob phyir// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ ༈ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa der// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*// bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ ༈ smon lam rgyal po 'di dag mchog gi gtso// mtha' yas 'gro ba kun la phan byed cing*// kun tu bzang pos brgyan pa'i gzhung grub ste// ngan song gnas rnams ma lus stong par shog ༈ rab dga'i sar gnas rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis// dgongs pa gcig tu btab pa'i smon lam mchog /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam ji lta bar// bdag dang 'gro bas myur du 'grub par shog ༈ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub chen por bsngo/ ༈ bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i smon lam 'di// dkon mchog rnam gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// log par 'dren pa'i phyogs las rnam rgyal nas// ji bzhin ma lus legs par 'grub gyur cig ༈ bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog ༈ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*// chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// dge 'dun mi phyed mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bsngo ba smon lam btab tshad 'grub par shog/ // 'khon gdung rat+na badz+ra rin po che'i bzhed dgongs ltar rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las par rtsa zhus pa'o/// / sarba maṅga laṃ//
